irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: On Holding / On Running (ONON) / ONON FY2025 Q3 / 原始表达：`integrated planning`

irExpressions.meaning: 需求与供应计划，用于判断供给是否跟得上真实需求。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 需求与供应计划，用于判断供给是否跟得上真实需求。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Demand and supply planning is most visible when a brand can chase winners without flooding weak doors.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 需求与供应计划的能力，最能体现在既能追补畅销款、又不会向低效点位铺过量库存。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: On Holding / On Running (ONON) / ONON FY2025 Q2 / 原始表达：`demand and supply planning`

irExpressions.meaning: 经过设计的分销模型，强调渠道布局、库存控制和品牌稀缺性。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 经过设计的分销模型，强调渠道布局、库存控制和品牌稀缺性。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: An engineered distribution model protects scarcity by deciding where product should not be available, not only where it should be sold.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 经过设计的分销模型不仅决定商品在哪里卖，也决定哪些地方不该卖，从而保护稀缺性。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2026 Q2 / 原始表达：`engineered distribution model`

irExpressions.meaning: 半成品预生产，能提高响应速度，但需警惕库存和最终组装瓶颈。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 半成品预生产，能提高响应速度，但需警惕库存和最终组装瓶颈。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Pre-production of semi-finished goods improves speed only if final assembly can absorb the demand spike.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 半成品预生产只有在最终组装环节能承接需求高峰时，才真正提升响应速度。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2026 Q2 / 原始表达：`pre-production of semi-finished goods`

irExpressions.meaning: 预先分配给客户订单，说明库存或产能已经对应确定需求，降低滞销风险。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 预先分配给客户订单，说明库存或产能已经对应确定需求，降低滞销风险。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Inventory pre-allocated to customer orders carries less markdown risk than stock built for uncertain open demand.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 已经对应客户订单的库存，比面向不确定需求生产的库存更不容易产生降价风险。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2025 Q3 / 原始表达：`pre-allocated to customer orders`

irExpressions.meaning: 产能吸收，指产量提升后固定成本被更多产品分摊，从而改善利润率。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 产能吸收，指产量提升后固定成本被更多产品分摊，从而改善利润率。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Capacity absorption can lift margin even before pricing changes if factories run closer to planned utilization.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 如果工厂利用率更接近计划水平，即使价格不变，产能吸收也能改善利润率。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`capacity absorption`

irExpressions.meaning: 有意控制产能，通常用于维持稀缺性、价格纪律和渠道质量。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 有意控制产能，通常用于维持稀缺性、价格纪律和渠道质量。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Capacity constrained by design can support premium positioning, but it requires confidence that scarcity will not become lost sales.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 有意控制产能可以支撑高端定位，但前提是稀缺不会演变成销售流失。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 供应链、计划与运营弹性
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`capacity constrained by design`

irExpressions.meaning: 受控扩张，强调增长节奏由品牌、渠道质量和供应能力约束。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 受控扩张，强调增长节奏由品牌、渠道质量和供应能力约束。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: The controlled nature of expansion reassures investors that new doors are being added for productivity, not headline scale.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 受控扩张能让投资人相信新增点位是为了提升效率，而不是追求表面规模。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: On Holding / On Running (ONON) / ONON FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`controlled nature of our expansion`

irExpressions.meaning: 规模效率，指收入规模扩大后采购、运营或费用效率改善。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 规模效率，指收入规模扩大后采购、运营或费用效率改善。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Efficiencies of scale are convincing when distribution, procurement, and store labor improve at the same time.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 规模效率只有在分销、采购和门店人效同步改善时，才更有说服力。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: On Holding / On Running (ONON) / ONON FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`efficiencies of scale`

irExpressions.meaning: 利用既有核心产品系列的资产；franchise指被市场认知的产品系列，equity指沉淀的认知和商业价值。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 利用既有核心产品系列的资产；franchise指被市场认知的产品系列，equity指沉淀的认知和商业价值。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Capitalizing on existing franchise equity lets a brand launch adjacent products with lower education cost.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 利用既有核心产品系列资产，能让品牌以更低教育成本推出相邻产品。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: Deckers (DECK) / DECK FY2026 Q4 / 原始表达：`capitalizing on existing franchise equity`

irExpressions.meaning: 需求拉动模型，强调终端需求带动补货和生产，而不是向渠道硬推库存。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 需求拉动模型，强调终端需求带动补货和生产，而不是向渠道硬推库存。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: A pull model of demand is credible when replenishment follows consumer sell-through instead of management shipment targets.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 需求拉动模型的可信度，来自补货跟随消费者动销，而不是跟随管理层发货目标。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: Deckers (DECK) / DECK FY2026 Q4 / 原始表达：`pull model of demand`

irExpressions.expression: creating white space and taking share
irExpressions.meaning: 创造空白市场并提升份额；white space指尚未充分渗透的市场/品类空间。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 创造空白市场并提升份额；white space指尚未充分渗透的市场/品类空间。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Creating white space and taking share is strongest when the brand opens a new use case rather than only stealing volume from peers.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 创造空白市场并提升份额，最好来自开拓新使用场景，而不只是从同业手里抢销量。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: Amer Sports (AS) / AS FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`creating white space and taking share`

irExpressions.meaning: 有节奏推进美国批发渠道，强调顺序、质量和渠道控制。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 有节奏推进美国批发渠道，强调顺序、质量和渠道控制。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Strategically sequencing U.S. wholesale rollout protects the brand from overdistribution before the best partners prove productivity.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 有节奏推进美国批发渠道，可以避免在优质伙伴效率被验证前过度分销。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: Amer Sports (AS) / AS FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`strategically sequencing our U.S. wholesale rollout`

irExpressions.meaning: 单店四面墙经营杠杆，指单店销售提升后固定门店成本被摊薄。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 单店四面墙经营杠杆，指单店销售提升后固定门店成本被摊薄。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: Four-wall operating leverage turns store growth into profit growth when rent and labor are spread over higher sales.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 当租金和人工被更高销售额摊薄时，单店经营杠杆会把门店增长转化为利润增长。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济
irExpressions.source: Birkenstock (BIRK) / BIRK FY2026 Q1 / 原始表达：`four-wall operating leverage`

irExpressions.expression: payback period of less than a year
irExpressions.meaning: 不到一年回本周期，用于说明门店或资本投入的单元经济质量。
irExpressions.meaningZh: 不到一年回本周期，用于说明门店或资本投入的单元经济质量。
irExpressions.exampleSentence: A payback period of less than a year gives store expansion a capital-efficiency argument, not just a growth argument.
irExpressions.exampleZh: 不到一年回本周期让门店扩张具备资本效率逻辑，而不只是增长逻辑。
irExpressions.speaker: general
irExpressions.category: 扩张质量、品牌转化与单店经济

On today's call, Meghan and André will begin by discussing recent business developments across our regions and the plans and strategies we're implementing to drive improved performance.","zh":"新闻稿及随附的 10-Q 表季度报告可在公司网站 www.lululemon.com 的投资者关系栏目查阅。在今天的电话会议上，Meghan 和 André 将首先讨论各地区近期的业务发展，以及我们为改善业绩而实施的计划和策略。"},{"id":8,"startTime":109.78,"endTime":122.54,"speaker":"Howard Tubin","speakerType":"management","en":"Meghan will then discuss our detailed Q2 financials, the impact recent trends are anticipated to have on our performance for the remainder of the year, and our revised guidance outlook. The team will be happy to take your questions.","zh":"随后，Meghan 将详细介绍第二季度财务业绩、近期趋势预计对今年余下时间业绩产生的影响，以及修订后的业绩指引。之后，管理团队将回答各位的问题。"},{"id":9,"startTime":122.54,"endTime":135,"speaker":"Howard Tubin","speakerType":"management","en":"Before I turn the call over to Meghan, I'd like to remind investors to visit our investor site, where you'll find a summary of our key financial and operating statistics for the second quarter, as well as our quarterly infographic. Meghan, over to you.","zh":"在把电话交给 Meghan 之前，我想提醒投资者访问我们的投资者关系网站，那里提供第二季度主要财务和运营数据摘要以及季度信息图。Meghan，交给你了。"},{"id":10,"startTime":135,"endTime":138.5,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"Thanks, Howard. Welcome, everyone, and thank you for joining us.","zh":"谢谢你，Howard。欢迎各位，也感谢大家参加今天的电话会议。"},{"id":11,"startTime":138.5,"endTime":159.76,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"I want to start the call by taking you through our Q2 results, what we are seeing in the business today, and how this is informing our decision to lower our guidance for the full year. André and I will spend most of our time discussing North America and China mainland, what has happened since our last earnings call, and the actions we are taking across these markets to improve the trajectory of the business.","zh":"首先，我将介绍第二季度业绩、目前看到的业务情况，以及这些情况如何促使我们下调全年业绩指引。André 和我会重点讨论北美和中国大陆，包括自上次业绩电话会议以来发生的变化，以及我们为改善这些市场的业务轨迹而采取的行动。"},{"id":12,"startTime":159.76,"endTime":175.02,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"As you recall, we began the year with an action plan focused on three pillars: product creation, product activation, and enterprise enablement. A key objective of our plan is to strengthen our full price sales trajectory and position the company for long-term growth.","zh":"大家记得，今年年初我们制定了一项行动计划，聚焦三大支柱：产品创设、产品激活和企业赋能。计划的一项核心目标是改善正价销售轨迹，并为公司的长期增长奠定基础。"},{"id":13,"startTime":175.02,"endTime":196.2,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"In Q1, we saw some encouraging signs indicating we were moving in the right direction to strengthen performance in North America while continuing to expand our global growth engine. As we moved into Q2, we faced negative commentary in the media and social channels, which impacted traffic and softer than planned response to some new product launches, which contributed to a moderating sales trend.","zh":"第一季度，我们看到一些令人鼓舞的迹象，表明北美业绩正朝改善方向发展，同时全球增长引擎继续扩张。进入第二季度后，媒体和社交渠道出现负面评论，对客流产生影响；部分新品上市的市场反响也弱于计划，共同导致销售趋势放缓。"},{"id":14,"startTime":196.2,"endTime":211.42,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"As you have seen from our press release, Q2 revenue came in below our expectations, with the shortfall driven predominantly by China mainland, where revenue grew 4%. North America finished down 8% for Q2, slightly ahead of our guidance.","zh":"正如新闻稿所示，第二季度收入低于预期，缺口主要来自中国大陆，该地区收入增长 4%。北美第二季度收入下降 8%，略好于我们的指引。"},{"id":15,"startTime":211.42,"endTime":227.42,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"As we moved into Q3, while we are seeing good guest reaction to our activations and some of our newer styles, the overall response to our product launches remains inconsistent. We have continued to see pressure on the brand in both of our largest markets.","zh":"进入第三季度后，虽然消费者对我们的品牌活动和部分新款式反响良好，但新品上市的整体反响仍不稳定。我们最大的两个市场中，品牌继续承受压力。"},{"id":16,"startTime":227.42,"endTime":241.22,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"Based on our assessment of these current trends, we have updated our guidance for the remainder of the year. At the enterprise level, we have several key actions underway to improve our performance.","zh":"根据对当前趋势的评估，我们更新了今年余下时间的业绩指引。在企业层面，我们正在推进多项关键行动，以改善业绩。"},{"id":17,"startTime":241.22,"endTime":256.44,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"André and I will get into the regional detail in a moment. Our product teams are chasing into strong performers, including our Groove and Define styles, more aggressively than in the past, and working with vendors to strategically manage future inventory flows.","zh":"André 和我稍后会进一步介绍各地区情况。产品团队正以比过去更积极的力度追加 Groove 和 Define 等畅销款，并与供应商合作，对未来库存流入进行策略性管理。"},{"id":18,"startTime":256.44,"endTime":266.26,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"On brand, we are moving forward with our increased marketing investments in the back half of the year. We are seeing strong community engagement with our recent campaigns and activations.","zh":"品牌方面，我们正按计划增加下半年的营销投入。近期的营销活动和品牌激活获得了较高的社区参与度。"},{"id":19,"startTime":266.26,"endTime":275.34,"speaker":"Meghan Frank","speakerType":"management","en":"While we have not yet seen an impact on the top-line trajectory, we are encouraged by the response. trajectory and position the company for long-term growth.","example":"A healthier full price sales trajectory would show that product changes are improving demand before clearance activity declines.","exampleZh":"更健康的正价销售趋势可以说明，在清货活动减少之前，产品调整已经开始改善需求。"},{"word":"away-from-body silhouettes","definition":"Looser product shapes that sit away from the body rather than following a close-fitting form.","chineseDefinition":"宽松版型；指衣服不贴合身体、与修身紧身款相区别的产品廓形","irUsage":"用于分析消费者版型偏好迁移，以及新品能否抵消紧身裤等核心品类下滑。","collocations":["shift toward away-from-body silhouettes（转向宽松版型）","expand away-from-body styles（扩充宽松版型）"],"relatedExpressions":["relaxed fit（宽松剪裁）","silhouette mix（版型结构）"],"sourceSentence":"We remain committed to the category, but there are shifts occurring with guests looking for away-from-body silhouettes.","example":"The shift toward away-from-body silhouettes changes the sales mix and the inventory needed across women's bottoms.","exampleZh":"消费者转向宽松版型，会改变女装下装的销售结构和备货需求。"},{"word":"SKU density","definition":"The concentration of distinct stock keeping units in a store presentation, reflecting how much choice is displayed within a given retail space.","chineseDefinition":"SKU 陈列密度；指门店一定空间中呈现的不同货号数量，反映商品选择丰富度与购物体验之间的平衡","irUsage":"用于判断精简门店货号是否改善陈列清晰度和购物便利性，并跟踪转化率与单店销售是否受益。","collocations":["reduce the number of SKUs（减少货号数量）","simplify the store assortment（精简门店货品组合）"],"relatedExpressions":["assortment breadth（商品组合广度）","visual merchandising（视觉陈列）"],"sourceSentence":"We are seeing good results in our store, where we are implementing new ways to elevate the guest experience through updated fixture package, further reductions in SKU density, and increased localization of assortment.","example":"Reducing SKU density made the store easier to shop while leaving room for products tailored to local demand.","exampleZh":"降低货号陈列密度让门店更容易选购，同时为符合当地需求的产品留出空间。"},{"word":"product adjacencies","definition":"The way related products are positioned next to one another in a store to guide discovery, storytelling, and cross-category purchase.","chineseDefinition":"相邻产品陈列关系；指在门店中把相关产品相邻配置，以引导发现、讲述场景并带动跨品类购买","irUsage":"用于评估门店改造是否通过陈列逻辑提升购物便利性、转化率和连带购买。","collocations":["change product adjacencies（调整相邻产品陈列）","optimize product adjacencies（优化相邻产品陈列）"],"relatedExpressions":["visual merchandising（视觉陈列）","cross-category attachment（跨品类连带购买）"],"sourceSentence":"We are also better organizing the guest journey by changing product adjacencies and merchandising by activity.","example":"Better product adjacencies can increase attachment rates without adding more SKUs to the sales floor.","exampleZh":"更合理的相邻产品陈列可以在不增加卖场货号数量的情况下提高连带购买率。"},{"word":"pop-up conversions","definition":"The conversion of temporary pop-up locations into permanent stores after demand and productivity have been tested.","chineseDefinition":"快闪店转长期门店；指在验证当地需求和店效后，将临时点位升级为长期门店","irUsage":"用于判断长期门店承诺是否建立在已验证店效上，并评估临时点位转为长期点位的资本纪律。","collocations":["complete pop-up conversions（完成快闪店转长期门店）","evaluate pop-up conversions（评估快闪店转店）"],"relatedExpressions":["test-and-learn format（测试迭代型店态）","permanent location（长期门店）"],"sourceSentence":"Of the openings we have got in North America, about half of them are pop-up conversions where we have got evidence of strong productivity.","example":"Pop-up conversions reduce expansion risk because the permanent lease follows demonstrated store productivity.","exampleZh":"快闪店转长期门店先验证店效再签长期租约，因此能够降低扩张风险。"},{"word":"key market saturation","definition":"Additional store density in an existing priority market where the brand believes demand can support more locations.","chineseDefinition":"重点市场加密；指在已有重点市场中增加门店密度，前提是当地需求能够支持更多点位","irUsage":"用于区分进入新市场与在成熟高效市场继续加密，并判断新增门店的蚕食风险。","collocations":["pursue key market saturation（推进重点市场加密）","support market saturation（支撑市场加密）"],"relatedExpressions":["store density（门店密度）","white-space expansion（空白市场扩张）"],"sourceSentence":"The balance would be strategic presence and then key market saturation.","example":"Key market saturation is attractive when incremental stores expand reach without weakening existing-store productivity.","exampleZh":"新增门店能够扩大覆盖且不削弱既有门店店效时，重点市场加密才具有吸引力。"},{"word":"right-size the cost base","definition":"To align recurring expenses and operating capacity with the current scale and revenue outlook of the business.","chineseDefinition":"使成本基础与业务规模匹配；指根据当前收入规模和展望调整持续性费用与运营能力","irUsage":"用于判断收入承压后成本结构能否及时调整，同时保留产品和品牌等长期投入。","collocations":["right-size the cost base to the business（使成本基础与业务匹配）","right-size operating expenses（调整运营费用规模）"],"relatedExpressions":["expense reset（费用重置）","structural cost reduction（结构性降本）"],"sourceSentence":"I would say given current trends, we are taking a deeper look to right-size the cost base to the current business, with the still protecting the long-term trajectory of the business and really primarily product and brand, where we feel like we really need to move on the sentiment side as well as support our product engine moving into 2027.","example":"Management can right-size the cost base while preserving the product and brand investments required for a recovery.","exampleZh":"管理层可以调整成本基础，同时保留业务复苏所需的产品和品牌投入。"},{"word":"quarter to date trend","definition":"Performance observed from the start of the current quarter through the latest available date.","chineseDefinition":"本季度迄今趋势；指从当前季度开始至最近可获得日期的业务表现","irUsage":"用于检验指引是否与最新销售节奏一致，但不能替代完整季度结果。","collocations":["track the quarter to date trend（跟踪本季度迄今趋势）","support guidance with the quarter to date trend（用本季度迄今趋势支持指引）"],"relatedExpressions":["current trading（当前交易表现）","intra-quarter cadence（季度内节奏）"],"sourceSentence":"As we look to the second half, I would say our quarter to date trend does support how we've looked at the international business towards the back half of the year as well as China.","example":"The quarter to date trend supports guidance only when management explains how representative the observed weeks are.","exampleZh":"只有管理层说明已观察周次是否具有代表性时，本季度迄今趋势才能有效支撑业绩指引。"},{"word":"store shoppability","definition":"How easily consumers can navigate a store, understand its assortment, find products, and complete a purchase.","chineseDefinition":"门店易购性；指消费者在门店内浏览、理解货品、找到产品并完成购买的便利程度","irUsage":"用于评估精简 SKU、优化陈列和调整购物动线是否能够提升门店转化率。","collocations":["improve store shoppability（提升门店易购性）","enhance store shoppability（改善门店易购性）"],"relatedExpressions":["store navigation（门店动线）","shopping experience（购物体验）"],"sourceSentence":"It really connects back to our priorities of getting after brand sentiment with some of the activations we have planned, as well as some conversion actions we have, both in product and in improvements we are making there, and then some of the experience pieces that André spoke to in terms of store shoppability, and as well as the e-commerce enhancements we have made to the look and feel of our website.","example":"Improved store shoppability can raise conversion even when traffic remains under pressure.","exampleZh":"即使客流仍承压，改善门店易购性也可以提升转化率。"},{"word":"reversal of an incentive compensation accrual","definition":"The release of previously accrued performance-based compensation expense when expected payout levels decline.","chineseDefinition":"激励薪酬应计费用冲回；指预期激励奖金支付水平下降后，转回此前计提的相关费用","irUsage":"用于识别利润率改善中的一次性费用调整，避免把非持续性冲回外推至未来季度。","collocations":["record an accrual reversal（确认应计费用冲回）","benefit from an accrual reversal（受益于应计费用冲回）"],"relatedExpressions":["variable compensation（浮动薪酬）","expense true-up（费用校准调整）"],"sourceSentence":"Foreign exchange had 20 basis points of favorable impact. Excluding the tariff refund, gross margin was 50 basis points better than our guidance for a 410 basis point decline, driven by 40 basis points related to the reversal of an incentive compensation accrual and favorable channel and category mix, offset by slightly higher markdowns.","example":"An incentive compensation accrual reversal should be separated from structural margin improvement in the earnings bridge.","exampleZh":"在利润率桥接中，应把激励薪酬应计费用冲回与结构性利润率改善分开。"}]

audio.subtitles: [{"id":1,"startTime":0,"endTime":27,"speaker":"Operator","speakerType":"operator","en":"Hello, everyone. Thank you for joining us, and welcome to the Amer Sports second quarter 2026 earnings call. After today's prepared remarks, we will host a question-and-answer session. If you would like to ask a question, please press star one to raise your hand. To withdraw your question, press star one again. I will now hand the conference over to Omar Saad, Head of Investor Relations and Capital Markets. Please go ahead.","zh":"大家好。感谢各位参加 Amer Sports 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议。管理层准备发言结束后，我们将进入问答环节。如果您想提问，请按星号键 1 举手；如需撤回问题，请再次按星号键 1。现在我把会议交给投资者关系与资本市场负责人 Omar Saad。请继续。"},{"id":2,"startTime":27,"endTime":76,"speaker":"Omar Saad","speakerType":"management","en":"Welcome, everyone. Thanks for joining Amer Sports earnings call for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Earlier this morning, we announced our financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and the release can be found on our IR website, investors.amersports.com. A quick reminder to everyone that today's call will contain certain forward-looking statements within the meaning of the federal securities laws. These forward-looking statements reflect our current expectations and beliefs only. They are subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Please see the safe harbor statement in our earnings release and SEC filings. We will also discuss certain non-IFRS financial measures. Please refer to our earnings release for important information regarding such non-IFRS financial measures, including reconciliations to the most comparable IFRS financial measures.","zh":"欢迎大家。感谢各位参加 Amer Sports 2026 财年第二季度财报电话会议。今天早些时候，我们公布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的财务业绩，业绩公告可在我们的投资者关系网站 investors.amersports.com 查阅。提醒大家，今天的电话会议将包含联邦证券法所定义的前瞻性陈述。这些陈述仅反映公司当前的预期和判断，并受到可能导致实际结果出现重大差异的风险和不确定性影响。具体内容请参阅业绩公告和 SEC 文件中的安全港声明。我们还将讨论若干非 IFRS 财务指标，包括与最具可比性的 IFRS 财务指标之间的调节，请参阅业绩公告了解相关重要信息。"},{"id":3,"startTime":76,"endTime":100,"speaker":"Omar Saad","speakerType":"management","en":"We will begin with prepared remarks from our CEO, James Zheng, and CFO, Andrew Page, followed by a Q&A session until 9:00 A.M. Eastern. James will cover key operational and brand highlights, then Andrew will provide a financial review at both the group and segment level, and also walk through our updated guidance. Arc'teryx CEO, Stuart Haselden, and Salomon CEO, Guillaume Meyzenq, will join for the Q&A session. With that, I will turn the call over to James.","zh":"会议将首先由首席执行官 James Zheng 和首席财务官 Andrew Page 进行准备发言，随后进入问答环节，持续至美国东部时间上午 9 点。James 将介绍主要运营和品牌亮点，Andrew 将从集团和细分市场两个层面进行财务回顾，并说明更新后的业绩指引。Arc’teryx 首席执行官 Stuart Haselden 和 Salomon 首席执行官 Guillaume Meyzenq 也将参加问答。下面把会议交给 James。"},{"id":4,"startTime":100,"endTime":173,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Thanks, Omar. Our global momentum continued in the second quarter, with over 30% revenue growth and a strong operating margin expansion. All segments, geographies, and channels achieved strong double-digit growth, led by another exceptional quarter from Salomon Softgoods, a strong Arc'teryx omnichannel, and a Wilson Tennis 360 acceleration. We manage a portfolio of sports and outdoor brands that is very unique in the marketplace. All three of our primary growth engines, Arc'teryx, Salomon Softgoods, and Wilson Tennis 360 are still relatively small, with significant room to grow. First, I will recap key highlights from our three segments. Starting with technical apparel. Arc'teryx delivered another great quarter with broad-based strengths across regions, channels, and categories, including another exceptional performance in women's. Strong DTC momentum also continued, driven by a 17% technical apparel omnichannel.","zh":"谢谢，Omar。首先，我来回顾三个细分市场的主要亮点，从技术服装业务开始。第二季度我们的全球业务势头延续，收入增长超过 30%，经营利润率也显著扩张。所有细分市场、地区和渠道都实现了强劲的两位数增长，Salomon Softgoods 再次表现出色，Arc’teryx 全渠道业务表现强劲，Wilson Tennis 360 也加速增长。我们管理着一个在市场上非常独特的运动和户外品牌组合。Arc’teryx、Salomon Softgoods 和 Wilson Tennis 360 这三大核心增长引擎目前规模仍相对较小，拥有很大的增长空间。Arc’teryx 再次交出出色季度业绩，各地区、渠道和品类均表现广泛向好，女装业务也再次表现突出。DTC 动能继续保持强劲，技术服装全渠道业务增长 17%。"},{"id":5,"startTime":173,"endTime":245,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We believe Arc'teryx is a truly global brand with significant runway in all major markets and are encouraged by the strong double-digit growth across all four regions in Q2. The brand also resonates strongly across categories and consumer segments. I want to highlight our momentum in women's, which grew faster than any other category for Arc'teryx. Our confidence in the size and the scale of our women's opportunity is very large. Brand awareness and affinity with women is rising significantly as we improve fit, style, and function, and also build expanded assortments. Redesigning our core ABCG models for her, plus expanding feminine color palettes, is driving higher female traffic and conversion. In Q2, newness and the seasonal colorways generate over 60% of women's sales. Standout new franchises include the Singiura and Oria lightweight hiking styles, and also the Sonii utility vest and jacket.","zh":"我们认为 Arc’teryx 是一个真正的全球品牌，在所有主要市场都拥有很长的增长空间。第二季度四大地区均实现强劲的两位数增长，这让我们备受鼓舞。品牌在不同品类和消费者群体中都具有很强的吸引力。我想重点说明女装业务的势头，它的增速超过 Arc’teryx 的其他任何品类。我们对女装业务机会的规模和潜力都非常有信心。随着我们改善合身度、风格和功能，并扩充产品组合，女性消费者对品牌的认知度和亲和力都在明显提升。为女性重新设计核心 ABCG 款式，并扩大女性色彩组合，正在带来更高的女性客流和转化率。第二季度，新品和季节性色彩占女装销售额的 60% 以上。表现突出的新产品系列包括轻量徒步款 Singiura 和 Oria，以及 Sonii 多功能马甲和夹克。"},{"id":6,"startTime":245,"endTime":316,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Our remarkable success in women's bottoms with franchises like the Krakja, Rutja, and Nia pants is helping us unlock the female consumer from head to toe, driving higher overall spend. Turning to footwear, which had another great quarter, including strong double-digit growth across regions, led by both existing and new styles. Popular existing styles included Norvan LD 4 trail shoe, which continues to be our biggest volume driver, followed by the Konseal trekking shoes. In March, we launched the latest version of our technical trail running shoe, the Sylan 2, performing very well so far. We are excited to have eight Arc'teryx trail run athletes competing in the UTMB race in Chamonix next week. Looking forward, we are confident that Arc'teryx has an exciting pipeline of shoe releases for the upcoming years. Turning to our Veilance sub-brand, which had a solid growth in Q2 on a small base.","zh":"Krakja、Rutja 和 Nia 裤装等产品系列在女装下装业务上的显著成功，正在帮助我们吸引从头到脚的女性消费者，并带动整体消费金额提升。再看鞋类业务，本季度也表现出色，各地区均实现强劲的两位数增长，既有现有款式，也有新品推动。热销的现有款式包括 Norvan LD 4 越野鞋，它继续是我们最大的销量驱动款，其次是 Konseal 徒步鞋。3 月，我们推出了技术型越野跑鞋 Sylan 2 的最新版本，目前表现非常好。我们很高兴下周在夏蒙尼举行的 UTMB 比赛中，将有 8 名 Arc’teryx 越野跑运动员参赛。展望未来，我们相信 Arc’teryx 未来几年将拥有令人期待的鞋类新品管线。再看 Veilance 子品牌，第二季度在较小基数上实现了稳健增长。"},{"id":7,"startTime":316,"endTime":394,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We continue to focus on investing newness, further developing our collections, and expanding distributions. All of which is creating engagement and awareness in the marketplace. Turning to sustainability and the ReBIRD, which continue to be at the heart of Arc'teryx. In Q2, we added five new ReBIRD centers, bringing us to 47 total. Later this month, we will unveil an important new innovation, which combines our passion for sustainability with uncompromised technical performance. Unmountain, our renowned Chamonix alpine academy, was again a great success in July with over 15,000 visitors in the village over the weekend and more than 1,000 attendees in clinics. Our Mountain Academies are the world's premium mountain education events and the space for mountain enthusiasts of all levels to advance their skills and the knowledge through clinics on the mountain. We are especially proud that women now account for half of the academy participants.","zh":"我们将继续投资于新品，进一步开发产品系列，并扩大分销覆盖，这些举措都在提升市场参与度和品牌认知度。下面谈谈可持续发展和 ReBIRD，它们仍然是 Arc’teryx 的核心。第二季度，我们新增了 5 个 ReBIRD 中心，使中心总数达到 47 个。本月底，我们将公布一项重要创新，将我们对可持续发展的热情与不妥协的技术性能结合起来。我们在夏蒙尼打造的知名高山学院 Unmountain 于 7 月再次取得成功，周末期间村镇接待访客超过 15,000 人，参加课程的学员超过 1,000 人。我们的山地学院是全球高端山地教育活动，为不同水平的山地爱好者提供在山地课程中提升技能和知识的平台。我们尤其自豪的是，女性目前占学院参与者的一半。"},{"id":8,"startTime":394,"endTime":466,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Turning to Peak Performance, which delivered solid growth in Q2. The brand continues to reduce its Nordic dependency and is rationalizing its footprint in the region while seeing healthy growth in other parts of EMEA. For both Peak Performance and our winter sports equipment brands, we are excited that Freeride Ski will become an Olympic sport at the 2030 Games. Peak Performance sponsored the Freeride World Tour, and our ski equipment brand sponsor many of the professional freeride skiers. Now, turning to the Outdoor Performance segment, which was led by another outstanding quarter from Salomon Softgoods. The investments we are making to grow Salomon brand awareness and the distribution footprint are paying off, driving strong footwear momentum across regions, channels, and for both sport style and the performance products. I'd like to highlight a few factors that give us the confidence that Salomon is well-positioned to achieve its long-term potential.","zh":"再看 Peak Performance，第二季度实现了稳健增长。该品牌继续降低对北欧地区的依赖，并在该地区优化业务布局，同时在欧洲、中东和非洲地区的其他市场实现健康增长。对于 Peak Performance 和我们的冬季运动装备品牌而言，令人振奋的是，自由式滑雪将成为 2030 年奥运会的正式项目。Peak Performance 赞助了自由式滑雪世界巡回赛，我们的滑雪装备品牌也赞助了许多职业自由式滑雪运动员。下面转向户外运动业务，该业务再次由 Salomon Softgoods 的出色季度表现带动。我们为提升 Salomon 品牌认知度和分销覆盖所进行的投资正在产生回报，推动鞋类业务在各地区、各渠道以及运动时尚和专业性能产品中保持强劲势头。下面我想说明几个让我们相信 Salomon 能够实现长期潜力的因素。"},{"id":9,"startTime":466,"endTime":537,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Number one, global sportstyle momentum continues. Sportstyle is critical to developing Salomon's position as the modern outdoor sneaker brand. The XT-6 and the XT-Whisper franchises are resonating with a younger and a more diverse audience from technical sports in the mountains to culture and the community in the cities. We were excited to announce that Jisoo, the global superstar singer and actress, will be Salomon's new global ambassador. The news had amazing global coverage, reaching nearly one billion consumers across social platforms. Second, our performance lines are also working well. We continue to believe our new gravel franchise is helping to unlock the run category for Salomon like never before. Salomon is gaining traction in the run specialty channels in North America and EMEA. In July, we launched the Aero Glide 4 with a re-engineering upper using new mesh technology.","zh":"第一，全球运动时尚势头仍在延续。运动时尚对于确立 Salomon 现代户外运动鞋品牌的定位至关重要。XT-6 和 XT-Whisper 产品系列正受到更年轻、更多元消费者的欢迎，覆盖从山地技术运动到城市文化与社区的场景。我们很高兴宣布，全球巨星歌手兼演员 Jisoo 将成为 Salomon 的新任全球品牌大使。这一消息在全球获得了极高曝光，在社交平台触达了近 10 亿消费者。第二，我们的专业性能产品线也运行良好。我们继续相信，新的 Gravel 产品系列正在以前所未有的方式帮助 Salomon 打开跑步品类。Salomon 正在北美和欧洲、中东及非洲的专业跑步渠道获得牵引力。7 月，我们推出了采用全新网眼技术、重新设计鞋面的 Aero Glide 4。"},{"id":10,"startTime":537,"endTime":608,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We also recently launched the second generation of Genesis, a highly technical trail shoe. Salomon athletes were winning races in Q2, including Courtney Dauwalter earning her fourth Hardrock 100 title, validating Salomon's technical merit on the hardest trails. Third, Salomon continued to have excellent brand heat in Greater China and Asia, where we believe we operate the most productive and profitable sneaker shops in the industry. Greater China continued to deliver very strong double-digit growth in Q2, driven by strength across sportstyles, performance, and apparel. Our local for local apparel and accessories lines in China with technical products inspired by outdoor and trail running has also been gained traction the past few quarters. Beyond China, Salomon is also experiencing surging demands in Korea and Japan, very important markets, given their influence on global sneaker culture. Fourth, our epicenter strategy is working.","zh":"我们最近还推出了第二代 Genesis，这是一款技术含量很高的越野鞋。Salomon 运动员在第二季度不断赢得比赛，其中 Courtney Dauwalter 第四次赢得 Hardrock 100 冠军，验证了 Salomon 在最艰难越野赛道上的技术实力。第三，Salomon 在大中华区和亚洲继续保持很高的品牌热度，我们认为自己在这里运营着行业内生产效率和盈利能力最高的运动鞋门店。第二季度大中华区继续实现非常强劲的两位数增长，运动时尚、专业性能和服装业务均表现良好。我们在中国推出的本地化服装和配饰产品线，采用受户外运动和越野跑启发的技术产品，过去几个季度也逐渐获得市场牵引力。在中国之外，Salomon 在韩国和日本也面临需求快速上升的趋势，这两个市场对于全球运动鞋文化具有重要影响。第四，我们的核心城市策略正在奏效。"},{"id":11,"startTime":608,"endTime":676,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Focusing on key global metro markets is allowing us to build up Salomon's reach and presence in the right way. Our Tier 1 global epicenter, Paris, London, Shanghai, Beijing, Tokyo, New York, and Los Angeles, are all driving very strong sales momentum as well as rising brand awareness. We approach these markets by opening a handful of impactful brand stores in the most relevant locations alongside handpicked elevated wholesale doors. In these markets, we also invest in event partnerships, community activations, and the local media to build a strong and lasting connection with our consumers. We plan to adopt and expand this approach to several new major cities in the future, including Berlin, Seoul, Miami, San Francisco, Chicago, and Boston. Fifth is the strong demand we are experiencing in our home market, Europe, driving strong reorders, pre-orders, and sales through.","zh":"聚焦全球主要都市市场，正在帮助我们以正确的方式扩大 Salomon 的覆盖和影响力。巴黎、伦敦、上海、北京、东京、纽约和洛杉矶这些一级核心城市，都在带来非常强劲的销售势头和不断提升的品牌认知度。我们在这些市场选择最相关的位置开设少量具有影响力的品牌门店，并配合精心挑选的高端批发销售点。在这些市场，我们还投资于活动合作、社区活动和本地媒体，以便与消费者建立牢固且持久的联系。未来，我们计划把这一方法推广到更多主要城市，包括柏林、首尔、迈阿密、旧金山、芝加哥和波士顿。第五，我们在本土市场欧洲感受到的需求很强，推动了强劲的补单、预售和终端销售。"},{"id":12,"startTime":676,"endTime":739,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Sportstyle continues to be the biggest growth driver, but gravel is also impacting in Europe, supported by marketing campaigns, in-store events, and the running event activations. We are seeing high e-com growth in Europe, even as we expand our premium DTC and wholesale footprint. In markets, we have been very active hosting a gravel-focused running event called the Gravelander, sponsoring music festivals and artist collaborations. Most recently, we began a unique partnership with the Opéra national de Paris to outfit their dancers. Lastly, I will mention the U.S., which is the largest single sneaker market in the world, but still a small business for us. We know there's a strong demand for Salomon here, but still very limited distribution for consumers to find us.","zh":"运动时尚仍然是最大的增长驱动因素，但 Gravel 在欧洲也开始产生明显影响，这得益于营销活动、门店活动和跑步赛事激活。即使我们扩大高端 DTC 和批发覆盖，欧洲电商仍然保持较高增长。在欧洲市场，我们积极举办以 Gravel 为主题的跑步活动 Gravelander，赞助音乐节并开展艺术家合作。最近，我们还开始与巴黎国家歌剧院开展独特合作，为其舞者提供装备。最后谈谈美国。美国是全球最大的单一运动鞋市场，但对我们而言仍然是一个规模较小的业务。我们知道美国市场对 Salomon 有很强需求，但消费者能够找到我们产品的分销覆盖仍然非常有限。"},{"id":13,"startTime":739,"endTime":800,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Today, we are seeing a clear acceleration in North America as we leverage the rising brand awareness to expand its distribution with both new and existing wholesale partners, as well as our own stores and e-com. In Q2, we opened our first North America flagship stores on Fifth Avenue in the Flatiron District of New York City, offering both footwear and apparel. We continue to carefully expand our footprint and shelf space in existing wholesale partners, including Nordstrom, JD Sports, and Foot Locker. Lastly, before I switch to ball and racket, although Q2 is a very small quarter for our winter sports equipment franchise, Salomon, Atomic, and Armada, we are pleased that our brands continuing taking share despite challenging conditions in certain markets. Moving to ball and racket highlights.","zh":"如今，随着品牌认知度提升，我们正在扩大 Salomon 在北美的分销，与新的和现有的批发伙伴合作，同时发展自营门店和电商。第二季度，我们在纽约市 Flatiron 区的第五大道开设了北美首家旗舰店，同时销售鞋类和服装。我们继续谨慎扩大现有批发合作伙伴中的门店覆盖和陈列空间，包括 Nordstrom、JD Sports 和 Foot Locker。最后，在转向球类与球拍业务之前，尽管第二季度对于 Salomon、Atomic 和 Armada 这些冬季运动装备品牌而言是全年很小的季度，但即使部分市场条件充满挑战，我们仍然很高兴看到这些品牌继续提升市场份额。下面转向球类与球拍业务的亮点。"},{"id":14,"startTime":800,"endTime":868,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Ball and racket sales grew 24% in Q2, driven by continued strength in Tennis 360, both softgoods and rackets, as well as improved growth in baseball, golf, and inflatables. Our Tennis 360 strategy continues to resonate very well with consumers, from unique lines of tennis apparel and footwear to high-performance rackets. Wilson had a couple very big racket launches this spring, including a Q1 rollout of our iconic Blade franchise, version 10. This has been one of the strongest launches in our history and also the rackets for world number one Aryna Sabalenka. We also recently launched a completely new racket line called the Defy. This is our first ever power spin racket, which has been a growing segment of the racket market. Early results from the Defy are even exceeding the Blade v10 launch I just mentioned.","zh":"第二季度球类与球拍业务销售额增长 24%，主要由 Tennis 360 持续强劲的表现推动，软商品和球拍均有贡献；棒球、高尔夫和充气产品的增长也有所改善。我们的 Tennis 360 战略继续得到消费者认可，产品覆盖独特的网球服装和鞋类，以及高性能球拍。Wilson 今年春季推出了几款重要球拍，包括第一季度推出的标志性 Blade 产品系列第 10 代。这是我们历史上最强劲的新品发布之一，世界排名第一的 Aryna Sabalenka 也使用了这款球拍。我们最近还推出了全新的 Defy 球拍系列，这是我们首款主打力量和旋转的球拍，所处的细分市场正在增长。Defy 的早期表现甚至超过了刚才提到的 Blade v10 发布表现。"},{"id":15,"startTime":868,"endTime":939,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We continue to invest in new tour players, recently signing former world top five player Holger Rune, and the 17-year-old rising star Moïse Kouamé, both playing the Defy racket. Markéta Vondroušová, one of our highest profile head-to-toe athletes, has been creating great buzz for the brand with her unique Wilson Tennis outfits, reaching the semifinals at both Roland-Garros and Wimbledon. Wilson softgoods continue its exceptional trajectories with very strong growth across all four major regions. Also, baseball, golf, and inflatables saw improved growth in the quarter. Before turning it over to Andrew, I'd like to conclude by saying that given the broad-based momentum across our portfolio, a healthy and a growing premium sports and outdoor markets, and the world-class teams we have in place around the world, I'm very confident in the future outlook for Amer Sports. Andrew?","zh":"我们继续投资于巡回赛球员，最近签下了前世界排名前五的球员 Holger Rune，以及 17 岁的新星 Moïse Kouamé，两人都使用 Defy 球拍。我们的高知名度全套装备运动员之一 Markéta Vondroušová，凭借独特的 Wilson 网球服装为品牌制造了很高热度，并在法网和温网都打进了半决赛。Wilson 软商品业务在四大主要地区继续保持出色发展势头，增长非常强劲。棒球、高尔夫和充气产品本季度的增长也有所改善。在把会议交给 Andrew 之前，我想总结一下：考虑到我们整个品牌组合广泛的业务势头、健康且不断增长的高端运动和户外市场，以及遍布全球的世界级团队，我对 Amer Sports 的未来前景非常有信心。Andrew，请继续。"},{"id":16,"startTime":939,"endTime":1010,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Thanks, James. We had a great financial performance in Q2 across the P&L, with strong sales growth, margin expansion, and EPS growth. The investments we're making are paying off, driving strong momentum across each of our three biggest opportunities, Arc'teryx, Salomon Softgoods, and Wilson Tennis 360. In Q2, Amer Sports grew sales 32% on a reported basis, or 30% ex-currency. Our three growth engines all eclipsed 20% growth, with technical apparel and outdoor performance growing more than 30%. By channel, the group continues to be driven by D2C, which grew 40%, led by all three big brands. At the group level, D2C represented approximately 55% of revenue in Q2, marking a record high. Wholesale grew 24%, led by Arc'teryx and Salomon. Growth was also very strong across all geographies, led by Asia Pacific, which increased 60%, and China, which grew 36%.","zh":"谢谢，James。第二季度我们在损益表各项指标上都取得了出色的财务表现，销售额增长强劲，利润率扩张，每股收益也实现增长。我们对 Arc’teryx、Salomon Softgoods 和 Wilson Tennis 360 这三大机会所做的投资正在产生回报，带动这些业务保持强劲势头。第二季度 Amer Sports 按报告口径销售额增长 32%，剔除汇率影响后增长 30%。三大增长引擎的增速都超过 20%，其中技术服装和户外运动业务增长超过 30%。按渠道看，集团继续由 DTC 驱动，DTC 增长 40%，三大品牌均有贡献。集团层面，DTC 占第二季度收入约 55%，创历史新高。批发增长 24%，主要由 Arc’teryx 和 Salomon 带动。各地区增长也都非常强劲，其中亚太增长 60%，中国增长 36%。"},{"id":17,"startTime":1010,"endTime":1082,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"The Americas accelerated to +26%, and EMEA grew 20%. Turning to profitability. Adjusted gross margin increased 710 basis points to 65.8% in Q2, primarily driven by a one-time net tariff refund benefit of $64.3 million, or 390 basis points. Excluding this net tariff refund benefit, we generated more than 300 basis points of underlying gross margin expansion, driven by favorable pricing, product, channel, and geographic mix, as well as favorable transportation and duties costs. The benefit from lower tariff rates versus our plan during Q2 was relatively immaterial. Adjusted SG&A expenses as a percentage of revenues increased 20 basis points and represented 54.9% of revenues in Q2. SG&A leverage in both technical apparel and outdoor performance was offset by deleverage at ball and racket due to investments in Wilson Tennis 360, as well as higher Amer corporate expenses.","zh":"美洲地区增长加速至 26%，欧洲、中东和非洲增长 20%。下面谈盈利能力。第二季度调整后毛利率提升 710 个基点至 65.8%，主要由一次性 6,430 万美元的关税净退款收益推动，相当于 390 个基点。不考虑这项关税净退款收益，我们的内生毛利率仍扩大了 300 多个基点，主要受益于有利的定价、产品组合、渠道组合和地域组合，以及有利的运输和关税成本。第二季度实际关税税率低于计划所带来的收益相对不重要。调整后销售、一般及行政费用占收入的比例上升 20 个基点，第二季度占收入 54.9%。技术服装和户外运动业务的 SG&A 杠杆，被球类与球拍业务因 Wilson Tennis 360 投资以及 Amer 集团总部费用上升带来的去杠杆抵消。"},{"id":18,"startTime":1082,"endTime":1155,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Led by strong gross margin expansion, we generated a 730 basis point increase in our adjusted operating margin from 5.5% last year to 12.8% in Q2. Excluding the above-mentioned net tariff refund benefit, adjusted operating margin expanded 340 basis points. Corporate expenses were $68 million, up from $45 million in Q2 of last year, mostly related to higher IT, personnel, and deferred compensation expense. Depreciation and amortization was $113 million, which includes $55 million of ROU depreciation. Adjusted net finance cost in the quarter was $21 million, above the $15 million guidance, primarily due to higher cost of hedging and currency losses. In the quarter, our adjusted income tax expense was $50 million, which equates to an adjusted effective tax rate of 27%. Adjusted net income in Q2 was $127 million, compared to $36 million in the prior year period.","zh":"在强劲毛利率扩张的带动下，调整后经营利润率从去年第二季度的 5.5%提升至本季度的 12.8%，增加 730 个基点。不考虑上述关税净退款收益，调整后经营利润率仍扩大 340 个基点。总部费用为 6,800 万美元，高于去年第二季度的 4,500 万美元，主要与 IT、人员和递延薪酬费用增加有关。折旧及摊销为 1.13 亿美元，其中包括 5,500 万美元的使用权资产折旧。本季度调整后净财务费用为 2,100 万美元，高于 1,500 万美元的指引，主要由于套期保值成本上升和汇兑损失。本季度调整后所得税费用为 5,000 万美元，对应调整后有效税率 27%。第二季度调整后净利润为 1.27 亿美元，而去年同期为 3,600 万美元。"},{"id":19,"startTime":1155,"endTime":1220,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $0.22, compared to adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.06 last year. Net tariff refunds benefited Q2 EPS by approximately $0.08 per share. Now, turning to segment results. Technical apparel revenues increased 32% to $674 million, led by Arc'teryx. Growth was fueled by 34% D2C expansion, including a 17% omnicom. Technical apparel wholesale revenues grew 27%. In Q2, we opened net eight new Arc'teryx stores globally, and we continue to plan 30-35 net new Arc'teryx stores for the full year of 2026 across all markets. Regionally, the technical apparel growth rate was led by Asia-Pacific, followed by accelerating growth in EMEA and Americas, followed by Greater China. All regions continue to grow strong double digits.","zh":"调整后摊薄每股收益为 0.22 美元，去年同期为 0.06 美元。关税净退款使第二季度每股收益增加约 0.08 美元。下面转向细分市场业绩。技术服装收入增长 32%至 6.74 亿美元，主要由 Arc’teryx 带动。收入增长由 DTC 增长 34%推动，其中包括 17%的全渠道增长。技术服装批发收入增长 27%。第二季度，我们在全球净新增 8 家 Arc’teryx 门店，并继续计划 2026 年全年在各市场净新增 30 至 35 家 Arc’teryx 门店。区域方面，技术服装增长由亚太领跑，其次是增长加速的欧洲、中东和非洲及美洲，再其次是大中华区。所有地区仍保持强劲的两位数增长。"},{"id":20,"startTime":1220,"endTime":1285,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Not only is the brand seeing a nice acceleration in North America and EMEA, the largest outdoor markets in the world, Greater China continued to deliver strong growth and maintain exceptional profitability in Q2. We finished Q2 with approximately 140 Arc'teryx stores in Greater China between owned and franchise, and believe this could be 200 long-term. We are planning 10-12 net new store openings in Greater China for the full year of 2026, with openings weighted toward second half and Q4. We had one net China opening in Q2, the Chengdu flagship store, which spans over 7,000 sq ft and two levels, featuring a distinctive cliff house design. Arc'teryx growth continued to accelerate in North America in Q2, and we delivered strong double-digit omni comps in the U.S. We are seeing significant progress in U.S. brand awareness, rising by approximately 50% versus last fall, led by top-of-funnel marketing.","zh":"品牌在全球最大的户外市场北美和欧洲、中东及非洲的增长都在加速；与此同时，大中华区第二季度继续实现强劲增长并保持出色盈利能力。第二季度末，我们在大中华区拥有约 140 家 Arc’teryx 门店，包括自营和加盟门店，我们认为长期来看这一数字可能达到 200 家。2026 年全年我们计划在大中华区净新增 10 至 12 家门店，开店主要集中在下半年和第四季度。第二季度我们在中国净新增 1 家门店，即成都旗舰店。该店面积超过 7,000 平方英尺，分为两层，采用具有辨识度的悬崖屋设计。第二季度 Arc’teryx 在北美的增长继续加速，美国全渠道同店销售实现强劲的两位数增长。美国品牌认知度也取得显著进展，较去年秋季提升约 50%，主要由漏斗顶部营销带动。"},{"id":21,"startTime":1285,"endTime":1323,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We also will focus on further leveraging brand experience and community to unlock higher conversions in the U.S. Q2 store openings in North America include Oakridge Park in Vancouver and Southdale in Minnesota, both very elevated presentations of the brand. We now have 75 stores in North America, which we believe could be 200 doors over time. In the U.S., we are expanding into a new partnership with Dick's Sporting Goods, where we will be entering 15 hand-selected premium House of Sport locations for fall/winter 2026.","zh":"我们还将进一步利用品牌体验和社区活动，释放美国市场更高的转化率。第二季度北美新开门店包括温哥华 Oakridge Park 和明尼苏达 Southdale，两家门店都对品牌进行了高端呈现。目前我们在北美拥有 75 家门店，长期来看这一数字可能达到 200 家。在美国，我们正在与 Dick’s Sporting Goods 开展新的合作，计划在 2026 年秋冬季进入 15 家精选的高端 House of Sport 门店。"},{"id":22,"startTime":1323,"endTime":1353,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Arc'teryx will be showcased in elevated and experiential shop-in-shop formats with a particular emphasis on the core outerwear offerings and including footwear. This is still in the test and learn stage, but has the potential to expand further over time. EMEA remains Arc'teryx's most under-penetrated market, and we are continuing to open great locations, including Oslo and Copenhagen in Q2, both off to exceptional starts.","zh":"Arc’teryx 将以高端、体验式店中店形式呈现，重点展示核心外套产品，同时包括鞋类。这一合作仍处于测试和学习阶段，但未来有可能进一步扩大。欧洲、中东和非洲仍是 Arc’teryx 渗透率最低的市场，我们继续在当地开设优质门店，包括第二季度在奥斯陆和哥本哈根开设的门店，两家店开业初期都表现非常出色。"},{"id":23,"startTime":1353,"endTime":1420,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We now have 19 stores across EMEA, and we believe the market could support 75+ over the long term. Margin expansion was driven by both gross margin expansion and SG&A leverage on strong sales. Moving to our outdoor performance segment, which saw revenues increase 37% to $569 million, driven by continued very strong performance in Salomon footwear and apparel. By channel, outdoor performance D2C grew 52%, led by new doors and higher productivity across markets, especially Greater China, APAC, and the Americas. Outdoor performance achieved a 28% omnicom with strength in both stores and e-commerce. E-com is continuing to grow across regions driven by sports style momentum and higher traffic, especially in the Americas and APAC.","zh":"目前我们在欧洲、中东和非洲拥有 19 家门店，长期来看我们认为该市场可以支持 75 家以上门店。技术服装调整后经营利润率提升 470 个基点至 18.8%，其中包括关税净退款带来的 170 个基点收益。利润率扩张既来自毛利率提升，也来自强劲销售带来的 SG&A 杠杆。下面转向户外运动业务，该业务收入增长 37%至 5.69 亿美元，主要由 Salomon 鞋类和服装业务持续强劲的表现推动。按渠道看，户外运动 DTC 增长 52%，主要由新增门店和各市场生产效率提升带动，尤其来自大中华区、亚太和美洲。户外运动业务实现 28%的全渠道增长，门店和电商均表现强劲。电商继续在各地区增长，主要由运动时尚势头和客流增加推动，尤其是在美洲和亚太地区。"},{"id":24,"startTime":1420,"endTime":1477,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Wholesale grew 25%, driven by strong sell-through and reorders for sports style as well as door count expansion. Regionally, the outdoor performance growth rate was led by APAC, Greater China, and accelerating growth in the Americas, followed by EMEA. The popularity of Salomon footwear continues to inflect globally, and we are doing everything we can to ensure we are well-positioned to fully develop this large opportunity in the right way over time and across markets. In Asia, D2C continues to be the critical growth channel for Salomon, led by our highly productive Salomon shops. We opened 13 net new Salomon shops in Greater China this quarter, including both owned stores and partner stores, bringing our total count at quarter end to 315 doors with the potential for 400-500 doors over time.","zh":"批发增长 25%，主要由运动时尚产品强劲的终端销售和补单，以及门店数量增加推动。区域方面，户外运动增长由亚太、大中华区和增长加速的美洲领跑，其次是欧洲、中东和非洲。Salomon 鞋类的全球受欢迎程度继续明显提升，我们正在尽一切努力，确保能够以正确的方式、在不同时间和市场充分开发这一重大机会。在亚洲，DTC 仍是 Salomon 的关键增长渠道，由生产效率很高的 Salomon 门店带动。本季度我们在大中华区净新增 13 家 Salomon 门店，包括自营和合作伙伴门店，使季度末门店总数达到 315 家，长期来看有潜力达到 400 至 500 家。"},{"id":25,"startTime":1477,"endTime":1537,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"For the full year of 2026, we continue to expect to open 45 net new stores in Greater China. We are focused on both expanding and upgrading the fleet with larger format, more productive doors, and the highest traffic shopping centers and space to incorporate footwear and apparel. For example, we recently upgraded the best performing Salomon store in China, Shenyang MixC. The new shop performed very well in its first month, demonstrating that even high productivity doors can benefit from an upgrade. In APAC, another region where Salomon has experienced an explosive growth, we opened net seven new stores in Q2 across Japan, Korea, and Australia. Salomon's overall brand awareness and desirability continues to grow very rapidly in Asia for both sport style and performance. In the Americas, as James mentioned, Salomon footwear is continuing to see a material growth acceleration.","zh":"2026 年全年，我们继续预计在大中华区净新增 45 家门店。我们将扩大并升级门店网络，重点发展面积更大、生产效率更高的门店，并进入客流量最高的购物中心，同时增加展示鞋类和服装的空间。例如，我们最近升级了中国表现最好的 Salomon 门店之一沈阳万象城店。新店开业第一个月表现非常好，说明即使是生产效率很高的门店，也能从升级中受益。在亚太地区这个 Salomon 增长同样迅猛的市场，我们第二季度在日本、韩国和澳大利亚净新增 7 家门店。无论是运动时尚还是专业性能产品，Salomon 在亚洲的整体品牌认知度和吸引力都在快速提升。在美洲，正如 James 所提到的，Salomon 鞋类业务继续出现明显的增长加速。"},{"id":26,"startTime":1537,"endTime":1593,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"The brand is seeing great D2C demand in stores and e-com in both sport style and performance. We are pleased to see traffic is up very strongly in e-com, which tracks our expanding geographic presence, distribution, and awareness across key cities. As we shared on our last call and aligning with our epicenter strategy, Salomon has begun to expand into a small number of key wholesale doors with important U.S. sneaker retailers such as Nordstrom, Foot Locker, and JD Sports. It is still in the early stages, but these channels are performing very well in terms of pre-orders, sell-through, and reorders. We will continue to selectively expand with these retailers over the next couple of years. We are also expanding our own retail footprint in North America, including our first flagship store on Fifth Avenue in the Flatiron District of New York City.","zh":"无论在门店还是电商，Salomon 在运动时尚和专业性能产品上的 DTC 需求都很强。我们很高兴看到电商客流大幅增长，这与我们在主要城市不断扩大的地域覆盖、分销网络和品牌认知度相一致。正如我们在上次电话会议中分享的，并且与核心城市策略保持一致，Salomon 已经开始进入美国重要运动鞋零售商的少量关键批发销售点，包括 Nordstrom、Foot Locker 和 JD Sports。目前仍处于早期阶段，但这些渠道在预售、终端销售和补单方面表现非常好。未来几年，我们将继续与这些零售商有选择地扩大合作。我们也在扩大北美自营零售覆盖，包括位于纽约市 Flatiron 区第五大道的首家旗舰店。"},{"id":27,"startTime":1593,"endTime":1644,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"The store is the first one in North America to carry a wide range of both footwear and apparel and is off to a very strong start. The new Salomon store in the Upper West Side of New York City also continues to perform very well. Looking ahead, as we expand our Los Angeles epicenter, we are planning a Beverly Hills location for October. We will continue to focus on our epicenter strategy in 2026 and beyond, particularly New York, Los Angeles, Miami, and San Francisco. We continue to plan to open seven to 10 new Salomon shops in the Americas this year. In EMEA, key epicenters Paris and London are seeing strong growth. We are also further developing other European markets, including a Barcelona shop that opened in July.","zh":"这家门店是北美第一家同时销售丰富鞋类和服装产品的 Salomon 门店，目前开局非常强劲。纽约市上西区的新 Salomon 门店也继续表现良好。展望未来，随着我们扩大洛杉矶核心城市布局，我们计划 10 月在比佛利山开设门店。2026 年及以后，我们将继续聚焦核心城市策略，尤其是纽约、洛杉矶、迈阿密和旧金山。今年我们继续计划在美洲开设 7 至 10 家新的 Salomon 门店。在欧洲、中东和非洲，巴黎和伦敦这两个核心城市增长强劲。我们还在进一步开发其他欧洲市场，包括 7 月开业的巴塞罗那门店。"},{"id":28,"startTime":1644,"endTime":1713,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Lastly, while Q2 is by far the smallest quarter of the year for our winter sports equipment franchises, we are encouraged by the positive order book trends and continued market share gain despite challenging weather and market conditions. The demand for ski vacations in the mountains remains high and consistent, and the core alpine on-piste market is healthy despite inconsistent snow conditions, as most top ski resorts now have excellent snowmaking capabilities. Outdoor Performance adjusted operating profit margin expanded 800 basis points from last year to 14.6% in Q2, including a 270 basis point positive impact from net tariff refunds. This improvement was largely driven by gross margin expansion due to mix shift benefits and SG&A leverage on strong sales. Moving to Ball and Racket, where revenue increased 24% to $390 million, driven by softgoods and racket sports. We continue to see very strong momentum in Tennis 360 globally.","zh":"最后，虽然第二季度远小于冬季运动装备产品系列的其他季度，但尽管天气和市场环境充满挑战，我们仍受到积极订单簿趋势和持续市场份额提升的鼓舞。山地滑雪度假的需求仍然很高且保持稳定；尽管降雪条件不稳定，核心高山雪道滑雪市场仍然健康，因为如今大多数顶级滑雪度假区都具备出色的造雪能力。第二季度户外运动调整后经营利润率较去年提升 800 个基点至 14.6%，其中包括关税净退款带来的 270 个基点正面影响。此次改善主要来自产品组合变化带来的毛利率扩张，以及强劲销售带来的 SG&A 杠杆。下面转向球类与球拍业务，该业务收入增长 24%至 3.90 亿美元，主要由软商品和球拍业务推动。我们继续看到 Tennis 360 在全球保持非常强劲的势头。"},{"id":29,"startTime":1713,"endTime":1775,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"By category, the growth was led by softgoods up very strong double digits with continued momentum in all regions. Rackets growth was also strong across the board, driven by China, APAC, and EMEA. Performance rackets grew more than 50%, driven by the very strong Blade v10 launch. We are also seeing padel gaining momentum, and it has become one of the top five revenue drivers in Q2. Beyond tennis, we saw a return to growth in baseball after slower sell-in last quarter. Golf and inflatables also saw solid growth in the quarter. All regions generated double-digit growth for Ball and Racket led by Greater China, APAC, and EMEA, followed by the Americas. We opened 12 net new Wilson brand stores in Q2, with the majority split between Greater China and APAC. We have extensive store opening plans for China given the performance of existing Wilson Tennis 360 shops there.","zh":"按品类看，增长由软商品领跑，增速非常强劲，各地区势头持续。球拍业务整体增长也很强，主要由中国、亚太和欧洲、中东及非洲带动。高性能球拍增长超过 50%，主要受 Blade v10 强劲发布表现推动。我们还看到板式网球开始获得势头，并在第二季度成为收入前五大驱动因素之一。在网球之外，继上一季度较慢的批发出货后，棒球业务恢复增长。高尔夫和充气产品本季度也实现稳健增长。球类与球拍业务所有地区都实现两位数增长，其中大中华区、亚太和欧洲、中东及非洲领跑，其次是美洲。第二季度我们净新增 12 家 Wilson 品牌门店，大部分位于大中华区和亚太地区。鉴于中国现有 Wilson Tennis 360 门店表现良好，我们在中国制定了大量开店计划。"},{"id":30,"startTime":1775,"endTime":1830,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"For the full year, we continue to plan to open approximately 40 net new Wilson Tennis 360 shops in China between owned and partner doors. APAC continues to drive meaningful Wilson growth, driven by softgoods in Korea and rackets in Japan. In North America, we saw strong growth across channels as baseball and inflatables rebounded. We have also continued to expand our Tennis 360 offering into more Dick's Sporting Goods locations, including House of Sport, and are now in 450 Dick's stores with our full head to toe to hand offering. Looking ahead to the rest of the year, please keep in mind that Ball and Racket's tremendous 24% growth in Q2 benefited from some big product launches and related sell-in, and we do not expect this level of growth on an ongoing basis.","zh":"全年而言，我们继续计划在中国新增约 40 家 Wilson Tennis 360 门店，包括自营和合作伙伴门店。亚太地区继续推动 Wilson 增长，韩国主要由软商品带动，日本主要由球拍带动。在北美，随着棒球和充气产品反弹，各渠道均实现强劲增长。我们还继续把 Tennis 360 产品扩展到更多 Dick’s Sporting Goods 门店，包括 House of Sport，目前我们的全套产品组合已进入 Dick’s 的 450 家门店，覆盖从头到脚以及球拍。展望今年剩余时间，请注意球类与球拍业务第二季度 24%的强劲增长受到了几款大型新品发布及相关批发出货的推动，我们预计这一增速不会持续。"},{"id":31,"startTime":1830,"endTime":1900,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"Ball and Racket segment adjusted operating profit margin increased 1,300 basis points to 17.2%, including a 970 basis point benefit from net tariff refunds. The underlying margin expansion was driven by favorable pricing, product, channel, and region mix. This was slightly offset by higher SG&A and our intentional decision to invest behind Wilson softgoods, including Tennis Tour Pros. Turning to the group balance sheet. We ended the quarter with $573 million of net cash and exited the quarter with inventories up 19% year-over-year, well below our 32% sales growth. We are very comfortable with the level and quality of our inventory and happy to see the inventory levels normalize versus revenues earlier than planned. Driven by strong profit growth and disciplined working capital management, we generated $339 million of operating cash flow in the first half of 2026, compared to $108 million last year.","zh":"球类与球拍业务调整后经营利润率提升 1,300 个基点至 17.2%，其中包括关税净退款带来的 970 个基点收益。内生利润率扩张来自有利的定价、产品组合、渠道组合和地区组合。较高的 SG&A，以及我们有意投资 Wilson 软商品业务、包括网球巡回赛职业球员，对利润率造成了轻微抵消。下面谈集团资产负债表。我们以 5.73 亿美元净现金结束本季度；季度末库存同比增长 19%，明显低于 32%的销售增长。我们对库存的水平和质量都非常满意，也很高兴看到库存相对于收入的水平早于计划恢复正常。受强劲利润增长和严格营运资金管理推动，2026 年上半年我们实现经营现金流 3.39 亿美元，而去年同期为 1.08 亿美元。"},{"id":32,"startTime":1900,"endTime":1933,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"For the full year of 2026, we continue to expect to generate solid operating cash flow growth versus 2025 levels. Now moving to guidance. We had another great financial performance this second quarter across the P&L with strong sales growth, margin expansion, and EPS growth. The investments we have been making in our brands are paying off in the form of exceptional trends across each of our three biggest opportunities, Arc'teryx, Salomon Softgoods, and Wilson Tennis 360.","zh":"2026 年全年，我们继续预计经营现金流将较 2025 年实现稳健增长。下面转向业绩指引。第二季度我们在损益表各项指标上再次取得出色财务表现，销售额增长强劲，利润率扩张，每股收益也实现增长。我们对 Arc’teryx、Salomon Softgoods 和 Wilson Tennis 360 这三大机会所做的投资正在产生回报，推动各项业务保持出色趋势。"},{"id":33,"startTime":1933,"endTime":1964,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We will continue to reinvest behind these early-stage growth engines to ensure high quality, long-duration growth, and strong brand equity over the long term. Our guidance assumes that the most recently announced Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 tariff rates remain in place for the remainder of 2026. We have already received the majority of our total tariff refund submission amount, and any remaining impacts will be negligible. Let's begin with the updated full-year 2026 outlook.","zh":"我们将继续对这些早期阶段的增长引擎进行再投资，确保长期实现高质量、长周期增长并保持强劲品牌资产。我们的指引假设最近公布的《贸易法》301 条关税税率在 2026 年剩余时间保持不变。我们已经收到关税退款申报总额中的大部分，剩余影响将可以忽略不计。下面开始说明更新后的 2026 年全年展望。"},{"id":34,"startTime":1964,"endTime":2022,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We are raising 2026 revenue growth guidance from 20%-22% to approximately 24%, which includes a 200-250 basis point currency benefit at current exchange rates. By segment, we are raising our Technical Apparel 2026 revenue growth guidance from approximately 22%-24%, to 25%-26%. We are also increasing our Outdoor Performance sales growth expectations from 22%-24%, to 27%-28%. Our Ball and Racket sales growth guidance goes from 10%-12% to approximately 14%. Turning to margins. We are fortunate to have the revenue and gross margin momentum that allows us to reinvest behind our three growth engines to ensure high-quality growth and strong brand equity over the long term, while also expanding our operating margins over time.","zh":"我们将 2026 年收入增长指引从 20%至 22%上调至约 24%，其中包括按当前汇率计算的 200 至 250 个基点汇率收益。分业务看，我们将技术服装 2026 年收入增长指引从约 22%至 24%上调至 25%至 26%；户外运动销售增长预期从 22%至 24%上调至 27%至 28%；球类与球拍销售增长指引从 10%至 12%上调至约 14%。下面谈利润率。我们有足够的收入和毛利率势头，可以继续投资三大增长引擎，确保长期实现高质量增长和强劲品牌资产，同时逐步扩大经营利润率。"},{"id":35,"startTime":2022,"endTime":2096,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"For 2026, we are raising our full-year adjusted gross margin guidance from 59%-59.5% to 60.5%-61%, which includes the 80 basis point benefit from the Q2 net tariff refund. We are raising our adjusted operating margin guidance from 13.4%-13.7% to 14.2%-14.5%. By segment, we are raising Technical Apparel adjusted operating margin guidance from approximately 22% to approximately 22.5%, which includes approximately 30 basis point of net tariff refund benefit from Q2. For Outdoor Performance, we are raising adjusted operating profit margin guidance from 15%-15.5% to 16%-16.5%, which includes approximately 50 basis points of tariff refund benefit. For Ball and Racket, we are raising the adjusted operating margin from 4.7%-5% to 6.7%-7.2%, which includes approximately 250 basis point benefit from tariff refunds.","zh":"2026 年，我们将全年调整后毛利率指引从 59%至 59.5%上调至 60.5%至 61%，其中包括第二季度关税净退款带来的 80 个基点收益。我们将调整后经营利润率指引从 13.4%至 13.7%上调至 14.2%至 14.5%。分业务看，技术服装调整后经营利润率指引从约 22%上调至约 22.5%，其中包括第二季度关税净退款带来的约 30 个基点收益；户外运动调整后经营利润率指引从 15%至 15.5%上调至 16%至 16.5%，其中包括约 50 个基点的关税退款收益；球类与球拍调整后经营利润率从 4.7%至 5%上调至 6.7%至 7.2%，其中包括关税退款带来的约 250 个基点收益。"},{"id":36,"startTime":2096,"endTime":2161,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We are assuming 2026 net finance costs of approximately $85 million, which is up from the previous $70 million guidance, mainly attributable to an increase in the cost of hedging, FX losses, as well as an increase in lease expense. We continue to assume an effective tax rate of 28%. Other operating income should be approximately $43 million for the full year. Corporate expense is now expected to be $240 million versus $220 million previously, primarily due to higher IT investment spend and deferred compensation expense. Net income attributable to non-controlling interests is expected to be approximately $30 million for the full year. We now expect adjusted diluted EPS of $1.27-$1.30 versus our prior guidance of $1.18-$1.23, which is based on approximately 585 million fully diluted shares. Other full-year modeling items to consider.","zh":"我们预计 2026 年净财务费用约为 8,500 万美元，高于此前 7,000 万美元的指引，主要由于套期保值成本上升、汇兑损失增加以及租赁费用上升。我们继续假设有效税率为 28%。全年其他经营收入预计约为 4,300 万美元。总部费用目前预计为 2.40 亿美元，高于此前的 2.20 亿美元，主要由于 IT 投资支出和递延薪酬费用增加。归属于非控股权益的净利润预计全年约为 3,000 万美元。我们目前预计调整后摊薄每股收益为 1.27 至 1.30 美元，而此前指引为 1.18 至 1.23 美元，该预测基于约 5.85 亿股完全摊薄股份。下面是全年模型中还需要考虑的其他项目。"},{"id":37,"startTime":2161,"endTime":2230,"speaker":"Andrew Page","speakerType":"management","en":"We are also assuming depreciation and amortization of approximately $450 million, including approximately $220 million of ROU depreciation. CapEx is still expected to be approximately $400 million, primarily to support our retail expansion and IT infrastructure investments. Now, turning to the third quarter guidance. We expect reported revenue growth for the group in the range of 18%-20%, which assumes an approximate 50 basis point tailwind from favorable FX impact at current exchange rates. We expect adjusted gross margin to be approximately 59% in Q3 2026, and an adjusted operating profit margin of 13.5%-14%. Keep in mind that last year's Q3 gross margin benefited by approximately 50 basis points from one-time inventory reserve adjustments. audio.learningVocabulary: [{"word":"shop-in-shop","definition":"a branded retail space operated inside another retailer’s store, allowing a brand to control presentation without running a standalone store","chineseDefinition":"店中店；指嵌入合作零售商门店、由品牌控制陈列和体验的零售形式","irUsage":"用于分析批发扩张是否保留品牌展示和消费体验的控制力","collocations":["operate a branded retail space"],"relatedExpressions":["concession space","wholesale presentation"],"sourceSentence":"Arc'teryx will be showcased in elevated and experiential shop-in-shop formats with a particular emphasis on the core outerwear offerings and including footwear.","example":"A shop-in-shop can extend a premium brand’s reach while preserving more control over the customer experience.","exampleZh":"店中店能够扩大高端品牌的覆盖，同时保留对消费者体验更强的控制力。"},{"word":"numeric distribution","definition":"numeric distribution measures the percentage or count of retail locations carrying a product, without weighting locations by their sales potential","chineseDefinition":"数字分销覆盖；指覆盖产品的销售点数量或比例，不按门店销售规模加权","irUsage":"用于区分销售点数量扩张与高质量门店覆盖，避免只看门店数量","collocations":["expand retail coverage","reach more retail locations"],"relatedExpressions":["weighted distribution","door productivity"],"sourceSentence":"One thing I want to highlight before we speak about how we develop is we are very much driven by consumer demands, and we are also driven by our epicenter strategy, so that we are looking at the consumer, not door by door and the kind of numeric distribution, but where do they sit and how much we are able to drive demand across the market.","example":"Numeric distribution can rise without a comparable improvement in demand if the new locations are low-productivity doors.","exampleZh":"如果新增销售点的生产效率较低，数字分销覆盖上升并不一定带来相应的需求改善。"},{"word":"net tariff refund","definition":"a net refund of previously paid tariffs, treated in the quarter as a one-time benefit that lifts reported margin or EPS","chineseDefinition":"关税净退款；指退回已支付关税后的净额，在本季度作为一次性收益影响毛利率或每股收益","irUsage":"用于把一次性退税和经营性毛利改善拆开","collocations":["receive a tariff refund","claim a tariff refund"],"relatedExpressions":["one-time benefit","tariff impact"],"sourceSentence":"Adjusted gross margin increased 710 basis points to 65.8% in Q2, primarily driven by a one-time net tariff refund benefit of $64.3 million, or 390 basis points.","example":"The net tariff refund should be separated from recurring pricing and mix improvements in the margin bridge.","exampleZh":"在毛利率桥接中，应将关税净退款与经常性的定价和产品结构改善分开。"},{"word":"underlying gross margin expansion","definition":"gross-margin improvement after excluding a specified one-time or external item, such as a tariff refund","chineseDefinition":"内生毛利率扩张；指剔除特定一次性或外部项目后，经营本身带来的毛利率改善","irUsage":"用于判断毛利率改善有多少可持续，不把一次性退税当作经营趋势","collocations":["deliver underlying margin improvement","exclude one-time benefits"],"relatedExpressions":["reported gross margin","margin bridge"],"sourceSentence":"Excluding this net tariff refund benefit, we generated more than 300 basis points of underlying gross margin expansion, driven by favorable pricing, product, channel, and geographic mix, as well as favorable transportation and duties costs.","example":"Underlying gross margin expansion is more useful than the reported increase when a quarter includes a large one-time benefit.","exampleZh":"当季度包含较大一次性收益时，内生毛利率扩张比报告毛利率上升更能说明经营质量。"},{"word":"softgoods","definition":"softgoods are textile-based products such as apparel and related accessories, distinguished from hardgoods such as rackets or equipment","chineseDefinition":"软商品；运动用品行业中通常指服装、纺织类产品及相关配件，与球拍或器材等硬商品相区分","irUsage":"用于拆分运动品牌的服装业务与器材业务，判断增长来源和品类结构","collocations":["softgoods sales","softgoods category"],"relatedExpressions":["hardgoods","apparel and accessories"],"sourceSentence":"Wilson softgoods continue its exceptional trajectories with very strong growth across all four major regions.","example":"Softgoods growth can improve the mix of a sports portfolio when apparel expands faster than equipment.","exampleZh":"当服装业务增速快于器材业务时，软商品增长可以改善运动品牌组合的品类结构。"},{"word":"go-to-market strategy","definition":"the plan for bringing a product or brand to customers through pricing, channels, retail partners, marketing, and sales execution","chineseDefinition":"上市及市场进入策略；指通过定价、渠道、零售伙伴、营销和销售执行把产品带给消费者的整体方案","irUsage":"用于分析新品、批发客户、门店覆盖和营销如何共同形成商业化结果","collocations":["bring a product to market","build distribution with wholesale accounts"],"relatedExpressions":["commercial rollout","route to market"],"sourceSentence":"If you think about all of those things that I just talked about, the two successful launches, the increased door count with Dick's, the revision of our go-to-market strategy and focus on our offerings to our key wholesale accounts, those were accelerators in the quarter, and they drove that outsized performance.","example":"A go-to-market strategy should explain how a product moves from launch activity to repeat sell-through.","exampleZh":"上市及市场进入策略应说明产品如何从发布活动走向持续终端销售。"},{"word":"test and learn","definition":"an operating approach that pilots a format or initiative, measures the results, and scales it only after evidence is established","chineseDefinition":"测试和学习式推进；指先试点、再根据结果决定是否扩大规模的运营方式","irUsage":"用于描述店中店、新渠道或新零售形式尚处于试点验证阶段","collocations":["pilot a new format","scale after testing"],"relatedExpressions":["pilot program","proof of concept"],"sourceSentence":"This is still in the test and learn stage, but has the potential to expand further over time.","example":"A test-and-learn approach lets management validate store economics before committing to a wider rollout.","exampleZh":"测试和学习式推进能够让管理层在大规模扩张前先验证门店经济模型。"},{"word":"flow-through","definition":"the conversion of incremental revenue into operating profit after the related variable costs and investments are absorbed","chineseDefinition":"利润传导；指新增收入在扣除相关变动成本和投入后转化为经营利润的过程","irUsage":"用于分析收入增长如何传导到经营利润，以及再投资为何会改变短期利润表现","collocations":["incremental profit conversion","convert revenue into profit"],"relatedExpressions":["operating leverage","profit conversion"],"sourceSentence":"As you think about the flow-through, just really think about the fact that we're going to deliver at the midpoint of our guidance.","example":"Flow-through should be assessed together with planned reinvestment because spending can delay near-term profit conversion.","exampleZh":"分析利润传导时，应结合计划中的再投资，因为支出可能推迟短期利润转化。"},{"word":"vendor sharing","definition":"a cost-mitigation arrangement in which suppliers absorb part of a tariff or input-cost increase","chineseDefinition":"供应商分担；指供应商承担部分关税或投入成本上涨影响的成本缓解安排","irUsage":"用于分析关税成本如何通过供应商分担、提价或其他方式降低对毛利率的影响","collocations":["negotiate vendor sharing","vendor sharing agreement"],"relatedExpressions":["cost sharing","tariff mitigation"],"sourceSentence":"Recall, though, if you think about the two-year stack, we essentially handled the tariff challenge last year, primarily through vendor sharing, which was netted out against this, and we essentially absorbed most of the hit of the tariff impact.","example":"Vendor sharing can reduce the immediate gross-margin impact of tariffs without relying entirely on retail price increases.","exampleZh":"供应商分担能够降低关税对当期毛利率的直接影响，而不必完全依赖零售端提价。"},{"word":"mix shift benefits","definition":"gross-margin or profit benefits created when the sales mix shifts toward more profitable products, channels, regions, or brands","chineseDefinition":"组合变化收益；指产品、渠道、地区或品牌结构向更高利润方向变化所带来的毛利率或利润收益","irUsage":"用于拆解毛利桥，判断利润率改善来自销售结构变化还是单纯提价","collocations":["benefit from a mix shift","mix shift contribution"],"relatedExpressions":["channel mix","geographic mix"],"sourceSentence":"This improvement was largely driven by gross margin expansion due to mix shift benefits and SG&A leverage on strong sales.","example":"Mix shift benefits can support margin expansion even when list prices are unchanged.","exampleZh":"即使标价没有变化，组合变化收益也可以支持利润率扩张。"}]

Before we begin, I will briefly remind everyone that today's call will contain forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Federal Securities laws.","zh":"今天与我一起参加电话会议的有创始人兼联合首席执行官 David Allemann 和首席财务官 Frank Sluis。在我们开始之前，我将简要提醒大家，今天的电话会议将包含联邦证券法含义内的前瞻性陈述。"},{"id":7,"startTime":54.93,"endTime":80.03,"speaker":"Liv Radlinger","speakerType":"management","en":"These forward-looking statements reflect our current expectations and beliefs only and are subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Please refer to our annual report on Form 20-F for the 2025 fiscal year, filed with the SEC on 3rd March 2026 for a detailed discussion of such risks and uncertainties.","zh":"这些前瞻性陈述仅反映我们当前的预期和信念，并受到某些风险和不确定性的影响，可能导致实际结果出现重大差异。请参阅我们于 2026 年 3 月 3 日向 SEC 提交的 2025 财年 20-F 表格年度报告，了解此类风险和不确定性的详细讨论。"},{"id":8,"startTime":80.03,"endTime":88,"speaker":"Liv Radlinger","speakerType":"management","en":"We will further reference certain non-IFRS financial measures such as adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA margin.","zh":"我们将进一步参考某些非国际财务报告准则的财务指标，例如调整后的 EBITDA 和调整后的 EBITDA 利润率。"},{"id":9,"startTime":88,"endTime":104.77,"speaker":"Liv Radlinger","speakerType":"management","en":"These measures are not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information presented in accordance with IFRS accounting standards. Please refer to today's release for a reconciliation to the most comparable IFRS measures.","zh":"这些措施不应被孤立考虑，也不能替代根据 IFRS 会计标准提出的财务信息。请参阅今天发布的最具可比性 IFRS 指标的调节表。"},{"id":10,"startTime":104.77,"endTime":119,"speaker":"Liv Radlinger","speakerType":"management","en":"We will begin with David, followed by Frank, leading through today's prepared remarks, after which we are looking forward to opening the call for a Q&A session. With that, I'm very happy to turn the call over to David.","zh":"我们将首先由 David 开始，然后由 Frank 主持今天准备好的发言，之后我们期待着开始问答环节。至此，我很高兴将电话转给大卫。"},{"id":11,"startTime":119,"endTime":127.12,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"Good afternoon and good morning to our global investor community. Thank you so much for joining us today.","zh":"我们的全球投资者社区下午好，早上好。非常感谢您今天加入我们。"},{"id":12,"startTime":127.12,"endTime":144.51,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"When we started On 16 years ago, we were told that the sportswear industry operated on a rigid set of rules, standard molds, standard distribution, and standard ways of doing business. We politely chose to carve our own path.","zh":"16 年前，当我们刚开始创业时，我们被告知运动服装行业有一套严格的规则、标准模具、标准分销和标准经营方式。我们礼貌地选择开辟自己的道路。"},{"id":13,"startTime":144.51,"endTime":158.03,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"When told it was physically impossible to put holes into the rubber sole of a running shoe, I took those industry-stranded molds and broke them. This is how CloudTec was born.","zh":"当被告知在跑鞋的橡胶鞋底上打孔在物理上是不可能的时，我拿起那些行业搁浅的模具并打破了它们。 CloudTec 就是这样诞生的。"},{"id":14,"startTime":158.03,"endTime":174.73,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"That single act of defiance forged our permanent innovation culture. At On, we are reinventing the mold again and again because it is the only way to build a premium global sports brand that will prevail for decades.","zh":"这一单一的反抗行为铸就了我们永久的创新文化。在On，我们一次又一次地重新发明模具，因为这是打造一个风靡数十年的优质全球运动品牌的唯一途径。"},{"id":15,"startTime":174.73,"endTime":183,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"Stepping into the roles of Co-CEOs just over 12 weeks ago is a strategic commitment to our founder-led DNA.","zh":"仅仅 12 周多前就开始担任联席首席执行官，这是对我们以创始人为主导的 DNA 的战略承诺。"},{"id":16,"startTime":183,"endTime":202,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"As On continues to scale into a multi-decade global company, we approach our growth with the precise focus of innovators and operators, but with the long-term patience of founders. We are not sprinting for short-term volume.","zh":"随着 On 不断扩大规模，成为一家拥有数十年历史的全球性公司，我们以创新者和运营商的精确关注以及创始人的长期耐心来实现增长。我们不会为了短期销量而冲刺。"},{"id":17,"startTime":202,"endTime":224.13,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"We are deliberately engineering for the multi-decade value of a premium brand. Alongside our President and COO, Scott Maguire, and our CFO, Frank Sluis, this leadership structure unifies our strategic intent with disciplined operational and financial execution.","zh":"我们正在刻意设计一个优质品牌的数十年价值。与我们的总裁兼首席运营官 Scott Maguire 和首席财务官 Frank Sluis 一起，这种领导结构将我们的战略意图与严格的运营和财务执行相结合。"},{"id":18,"startTime":224.13,"endTime":240.92,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"Relentless product innovation, a unique design culture, and brand equity remain at the very center of every decision we make. This commitment delivered another exceptional quarter of premium growth.","zh":"不懈的产品创新、独特的设计文化和品牌资产仍然是我们做出的每项决策的核心。这一承诺带来了另一个出色的季度保费增长。"},{"id":19,"startTime":240.92,"endTime":260,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"For Q2 2026, net sales reached CHF 850 million, a powerful 22% growth at constant currency. At the same time, we delivered industry-leading profitability, over 65% gross profit margin, and close to 20% adjusted EBITDA margin.","zh":"2026 年第二季度，净销售额达到 8.5 亿瑞士法郎，按固定汇率计算，强劲增长 22%。与此同时，我们实现了行业领先的盈利能力，毛利率超过 65%，调整后 EBITDA 利润率接近 20%。"},{"id":20,"startTime":260,"endTime":277.89,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"The strongest proof of the connection we are building is the extraordinary strength of our direct-to-consumer channel. The most premium expression of our brand, which delivered exceptional momentum in Q2, growing 34% at constant currency.","zh":"我们正在建立的联系的最有力证明是我们直接面向消费者的渠道的非凡实力。我们品牌最优质的表现，在第二季度表现强劲，按固定汇率计算增长了 34%。"},{"id":21,"startTime":277.89,"endTime":299.09,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"This was driven by deep, top-of-head consumer demand across all regions, with On's brand awareness increasing to 30% as a whole new generation of fans discovered the brand. We are proving that a brand can achieve global scale without eroding premium positioning or margin ambitions.","zh":"这是由所有地区深入、顶级的消费者需求推动的，随着全新一代粉丝发现了该品牌，On 的品牌知名度提高到了 30%。我们正在证明，一个品牌可以在不削弱高端定位或利润目标的情况下实现全球规模。"},{"id":22,"startTime":299.09,"endTime":317.59,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"We do not create exclusivity through artificial scarcity or hype. We scale by bringing superior technology, engineering, unique design, and cultural relevance to millions of consumers, capturing market share while fiercely protecting our margins.","zh":"我们不会通过人为的稀缺或炒作来创造排他性。我们通过向数百万消费者提供卓越的技术、工程、独特的设计和文化相关性来扩大规模，占领市场份额，同时大力保护我们的利润。"},{"id":23,"startTime":317.59,"endTime":333,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"On ultimately creates a highly defensible, scalable financial profile of a premium growth compounder. Our actions in wholesale this quarter are perhaps the clearest example of our premium strategy at work.","zh":"最终创建了一个具有高度防御性、可扩展性的优质增长复合企业的财务状况。本季度我们在批发方面的行动也许是我们的优质策略在起作用的最明显的例子。"},{"id":24,"startTime":333,"endTime":356.13,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"Momentum in our own channels was remarkably strong, with growth ahead of our expectations in all regions. On the other hand, in wholesale, the sell-out of some of our everyday running franchises tracked below our ambitions in a highly promotional multi-brand marketplace, particularly in the Americas.","zh":"我们自有渠道的势头非常强劲，所有地区的增长都超出了我们的预期。另一方面，在批发方面，我们一些日常跑步的产品系列的销售情况低于我们在高度促销的多品牌市场中的目标，特别是在美洲。"},{"id":25,"startTime":356.13,"endTime":364.81,"speaker":"David Allemann","speakerType":"management","en":"Clearly, this is something we are not pleased with.
