precise and consistent on-foot feel","chineseDefinition":"精准贴合；鞋类语境中指通过足部工程、材料和结构设计，提供精准且稳定的穿着贴合感","irUsage":"用于解释鞋类技术升级如何从材料创新延伸到穿着体验，并支持产品差异化和价格接受度","collocations":["fit consistency","engineered fit"],"relatedExpressions":["foot engineering","on-foot comfort"],"example":"Precision fit gives a technical footwear launch a clearer consumer benefit than a materials claim alone.","exampleZh":"相比单独强调材料，精准贴合能让技术鞋款的上市叙事更清楚地落到消费者体验。"},{"word":"artificial scarcity","segmentId":6,"sourceSentence":"We do not create exclusivity through artificial scarcity or hype.","definition":"manufactured limited availability used to create exclusivity or urgency, rather than scarcity arising from genuine supply constraints or demand","chineseDefinition":"人为制造的稀缺性；指通过人为控制可得性或炒作制造独特感和紧迫感，而不是来自真实供给约束或需求","irUsage":"用于区分品牌的高端定位是由真实产品吸引力支撑，还是依赖人为限量和短期炒作","collocations":["manufactured scarcity","exclusivity product claim can scale.","exampleZh":"经独立验证的性能表现，能为投资人判断高端产品优势是否可规模化提供更坚实的依据。"},{"word":"toe to head","segmentId":14,"sourceSentence":"At the same time, the expansion of our Vault Running collection saw apparel achieve a record 28% share of our running campaign net sales in Q2, proving our ability to complete the runner's uniform from toe to head.","definition":"describes extending a footwear-led offering across the full outfit, from shoes through apparel and other adjacent categories","chineseDefinition":"从脚到头的整体着装覆盖；指品牌从鞋类延伸到服装及其他相邻品类，完成完整穿着方案","irUsage":"用于分析鞋服品牌从单一品类向全身着装方案延伸时，品类扩张、客单价和消费者黏性的关系","collocations":["complete the uniform","cross-category assortment"],"relatedExpressions":["apparel extension","category adjacency"],"example":"A toe-to-head assortment can deepen the relationship with existing runners by covering more use occasions in one brand ecosystem.","exampleZh":"从脚到头的整体产品组合能够覆盖更多使用场景，深化品牌与现有跑者之间的关系。"}]

At this time, I'll turn the call over to Andrew Rees, Crocs Inc.'s Chief Executive Officer.","zh":"除非另有说明，所有收入增长率均按固定汇率计算。此时，我会将电话转给 Crocs Inc. 首席执行官 Andrew Rees。"},{"id":12,"startTime":113,"endTime":115.69,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Thank you, Abby. Good morning, everyone.","zh":"谢谢你，艾比。大家早上好。"},{"id":13,"startTime":115.69,"endTime":128.01,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Thank you for joining us today. We delivered a stronger-than-expected second quarter, driven by broad consumer demand for both brands and consistent execution of our brand strategies.","zh":"感谢您今天加入我们。在消费者对两个品牌的广泛需求以及我们品牌战略的持续执行的推动下，我们第二季度的业绩强于预期。"},{"id":14,"startTime":128.01,"endTime":151.71,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"This fueled our powerful value creation engine, generating strong free cash flow, which we turned to shareholders in the form of debt paydown and meaningful share repurchases. While Patraic will discuss our quarterly performance in more detail later, I would like to start by sharing several financial highlights and reviewing our performance by brand.","zh":"这推动了我们强大的价值创造引擎，产生强劲的自由现金流，我们以偿还债务和有意义的股票回购的形式将其转向股东。虽然帕特雷克稍后将更详细地讨论我们的季度业绩，但我想首先分享几个财务亮点并按品牌回顾我们的业绩。"},{"id":15,"startTime":151.71,"endTime":174,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"For the second quarter of 2026, we delivered record enterprise revenues of $1.2 billion, up 2% to prior year, including Crocs brand up 4% and HEYDUDE down 6%. This quarter marks an important inflection for both brands, including a major milestone as the Crocs brand exceeded $1 billion in quarterly revenue for the first time ever.","zh":"2026 年第二季度，我们实现创纪录的企业收入 12 亿美元，比上年增长 2%，其中 Crocs 品牌增长 4%，HEYDUDE 下降 6%。本季度标志着两个品牌的重要转折，其中一个重要里程碑是 Crocs 品牌季度收入首次突破 10 亿美元。"},{"id":16,"startTime":174,"endTime":187.02,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Another quarter of strong direct-to-consumer growth for both brands. Crocs brand DTC up 12%, including reduced promotional activity, and HEYDUDE DTC up 7% despite lower performance marketing spend.","zh":"两个品牌的直接面向消费者又一个季度实现强劲增长。 Crocs 品牌的 DTC 增长了 12%，其中包括促销活动的减少；尽管绩效营销支出有所下降，HEYDUDE DTC 仍增长了 7%。"},{"id":17,"startTime":187.02,"endTime":205,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Crocs brand international revenue growth was 7% and North America returning to slight growth, a key milestone for the Crocs brand. Meaningful return of cash to shareholders with approximately 2.3 million shares repurchased for $251 million and debt paydown of $31 million.","zh":"Crocs 品牌国际收入增长 7%，北美地区恢复小幅增长，这是 Crocs 品牌的一个重要里程碑。为股东带来了有意义的现金回报，以 2.51 亿美元回购了约 230 万股股票，并偿还了 3100 万美元的债务。"},{"id":18,"startTime":205,"endTime":219.22,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Furthermore, earlier this week, we received board approval for an additional $1.5 billion share repurchase authorization, which Patraic will speak about later today. Now to performance by brand, starting with Crocs.","zh":"此外，本周早些时候，我们获得了董事会批准额外 15 亿美元的股票回购授权，帕特雷克将在今天晚些时候讨论这一问题。现在按品牌介绍业绩，从 Crocs 开始。"},{"id":19,"startTime":219.22,"endTime":237,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"The second quarter continued to build on our strong start to the year as consumers responded positively to product newness and marketing activations across channels and geographies. This is evidenced through the progress we have made against our five strategic pillars.","zh":"第二季度继续以今年的强劲开局为基础，消费者对跨渠道和地域的新品和营销活动做出了积极反应。我们在五个战略支柱方面取得的进展就证明了这一点。"},{"id":20,"startTime":237,"endTime":249.33,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"First, we are driving brand relevance globally as the clog market share leader. During the quarter, we saw strength within our sport and fashion clog franchises, Crocband, Echo, and Crafted.","zh":"首先，作为木鞋市场份额的领导者，我们正在全球范围内推动品牌相关性。在本季度，我们看到了运动和时尚木鞋系列 Crocband、Echo 和 Crafted 的实力。"},{"id":21,"startTime":249.33,"endTime":268.67,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"These franchises enable diversification of our overall clog portfolio, allow better segmentation, and drive category relevance outside of our classic franchise. Starting with Crocband, demand has been broad-based across colors and iterations, including our latest introduction, the Crocband Runner.","zh":"这些系列使我们的整体木鞋产品组合多样化，实现更好的细分，并在我们的经典系列之外推动品类吸引力。从 Crocband 开始，各种颜色和迭代的需求都非常广泛，包括我们最新推出的 Crocband Runner。"},{"id":22,"startTime":268.67,"endTime":291,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"This focused introduction, which features our take on a retro sneaker trend, has been a strong performer amidst an exciting time for sports globally. Our Echo franchise continued to outperform globally, led by the Echo RO Clog and Mary Jane silhouettes, and we are building on this momentum with the recent launch of Echo II earlier this month.","zh":"这一重点介绍以我们对复古运动鞋趋势的看法为特色，在全球体育运动的激动人心的时刻表现出色。在 Echo RO Clog 和 Mary Jane 鞋款的引领下，我们的 Echo 系列在全球范围内继续表现出色，并且我们正在巩固这一势头，在本月初推出了 Echo II。"},{"id":23,"startTime":291,"endTime":314.82,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"The Crafted franchise continues to be led by our canvas and embroidery uppers, and as we head into fall, we're further differentiating our assortment with a more distinct cold weather offering. As for our classic franchise within North American wholesale, we are on plan with our strategy to tighten inventory and channel and further segment our business across key partners.","zh":"Crafted 系列继续以帆布和刺绣鞋面为主导，随着进入秋季，我们将推出更独特的寒冷天气产品，进一步使我们的产品类别脱颖而出。至于我们在北美批发领域的经典系列，我们正在计划制定战略，以收紧库存、优化渠道，并进一步在主要合作伙伴之间细分我们的业务。"},{"id":24,"startTime":314.82,"endTime":330.5,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"These actions, along with the green shoots we're seeing in our domestic DTC business, give us confidence in the stabilization and future growth of our icon. Second, we're scaling our product pillars outside of clogs through new category expansion.","zh":"这些行动，加上我们在国内 DTC 业务中看到的萌芽，让我们对我们这一标志性品牌的稳定和未来发展充满信心。其次，我们通过新的品类扩张，将我们的产品支柱扩展到木鞋之外。"},{"id":25,"startTime":330.5,"endTime":339.71,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Starting with sandals. This category represents our largest near-term diversification opportunity, and we continue to take material market share.","zh":"从凉鞋开始。该类别代表了我们近期最大的多元化机会，我们将继续占据重要的市场份额。"},{"id":26,"startTime":339.71,"endTime":350,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Within our three core style franchises, the Miami, Getaway, and Brooklyn, we're building on the success of prior seasons through new introductions and innovation.","zh":"在我们的三个核心风格系列中，迈阿密、逍遥游和布鲁克林，我们通过新品推出与产品创新在前几季的成功基础上再接再厉。"},{"id":27,"startTime":350,"endTime":363.73,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"One standout example of their success is within the Miami. New introductions such as the platform and round toe, as well as new materializations like the Miami Jelly, are driving heightened demand from consumers.","zh":"他们成功的一个突出例子就是迈阿密。厚底鞋、圆头鞋等新产品以及迈阿密果冻鞋等新材料正在推动消费者的需求不断增长。"},{"id":28,"startTime":363.73,"endTime":379.48,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Digital search trends further validate that this franchise is becoming increasingly well-known to new consumers. As we spoke about on our first quarter call early this year, we launched a Saturday Sandal, a personalizable two-strap silhouette.","zh":"数字搜索趋势进一步证实该系列正变得越来越为新消费者所熟知。正如我们在今年年初第一季度电话会议上谈到的那样，我们推出了一款周六凉鞋，一款个性化的两带鞋型。"},{"id":29,"startTime":379.48,"endTime":392.82,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"The initial launch drove exceptional response from our consumers and retailers globally, led by the metallic buckle iteration. As we look forward, we expect this franchise to continue to build meaningfully.","zh":"最初的推出在金属扣迭代的引领下，引起了全球消费者和零售商的热烈反响。展望未来，我们预计该系列将继续有意义地发展。"},{"id":30,"startTime":392.82,"endTime":412,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"More broadly, the momentum we have seen in our sandal category has strengthened the trajectory of our North America business, contributing to the return to growth we reported today. We expect this category to become an even more meaningful growth driver of our global business in 2027 and beyond.","zh":"更广泛地说，我们在凉鞋类别中看到的势头加强了我们北美业务的轨迹，有助于我们今天报告的增长恢复。我们预计这一类别将在 2027 年及以后成为我们全球业务更有意义的增长动力。"},{"id":31,"startTime":412,"endTime":438.33,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"Outside of sandals, we're driving strong consumer engagement within our lifestyle category, led by the classic ballet flat, which continues to see notable sell-outs globally, particularly in Asia. Within recovery, we leverage New York Giants players Jaxson Dart and Cam Skattebo to launch two new silhouettes within our Mellow franchise, a clog, and a closed heel offering, which features an updated look and comfort proposition.","zh":"除了凉鞋之外，我们还在以经典芭蕾平底鞋为首的生活方式品类中推动消费者的强烈参与，该品类在全球（尤其是亚洲）的销量持续大幅增长。在恢复过程中，我们利用纽约巨人队球员 Jaxson Dart 和 Cam Skattebo 在 Mellow 系列中推出了两款新款式：木底鞋和封闭式鞋跟产品，其特点是更新的外观和舒适度。"},{"id":32,"startTime":438.33,"endTime":447.97,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"The early demand we're seeing has been encouraging and reinforces the confidence we have in our overall diversification strategy. Turning to personalization.","zh":"我们看到的早期需求令人鼓舞，增强了我们对整体多元化战略的信心。转向个性化。"},{"id":33,"startTime":447.97,"endTime":467,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"As a category leader in this space, we aim to push the definition of what personalization can be beyond traditional Jibbitz charms. We have begun testing several innovations in the category, including sandal charms, which allow consumers to personalize franchises that don't support traditional Jibbitz charms.","zh":"作为该领域的行业领导者，我们的目标是推动个性化的定义超越传统的 Jibbitz 魅力。我们已经开始测试该类别的多项创新，包括凉鞋饰物，它允许消费者个性化不支持传统 Jibbitz 饰物的系列。"},{"id":34,"startTime":467,"endTime":484.52,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"We launched the program on a limited basis through our own dot-com and select stores, where we saw encouraging consumer response. The ability to personalize a growing portion of our product offering remains a powerful driver of consumer engagement and a key competitive advantage for our brand.","zh":"我们通过自营官网和精选商店在有限的基础上推出了该计划，我们看到消费者的反应令人鼓舞。个性化我们越来越多的产品的能力仍然是消费者参与的强大推动力，也是我们品牌的关键竞争优势。"},{"id":35,"startTime":484.52,"endTime":498.34,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"In addition, we are intentionally expanding into categories like bags and accessories, both of which saw meaningful growth during the quarter. Third, we're fueling consumer engagement through disruptive social and digital marketing.","zh":"此外，我们还有意扩展到箱包和配饰等类别，这两个类别在本季度都实现了显着增长。第三，我们通过颠覆性的社交和数字营销来促进消费者参与。"},{"id":36,"startTime":498.34,"endTime":518,"speaker":"Andrew Rees","speakerType":"management","en":"During April, we launched the Glad You Notice campaign, leveraging creative partnerships and a fully integrated media strategy to spotlight our sandal business. operating results, including changes to global trade policy, freight costs, and fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, geopolitical conflicts, including the ongoing Middle East conflict and related supply chain logistics and cost impacts, our current and long-term strategic objectives, the expected performance of our brands and demand for our products, the anticipated impacts of our brand, product, marketing, marketplace, distribution, and investment strategies, our product development plans and the timing and anticipated performance of product launches, changes in consumer behavior, our ability to acquire new consumers and gain market share, our ability to achieve our financial outlook and multi-year framework, including anticipated revenues, product mix, margins, expenses, inventory levels, promotional activity, anticipated rate of full price selling and earnings per share, the timing of wholesale and distributor shipments, our ability to maintain a premium full price global marketplace, statements regarding tariff refunds, and our ability to generate free cash flow and execute our capital allocation strategy, including potential share repurchases.","zh":"除历史事实陈述外，今天本次电话会议上所做的所有陈述均为前瞻性陈述，包括有关我们推动长期价值的能力、动态宏观经济环境以及对我们业务和经营业绩的相关影响的陈述，包括全球贸易政策的变化、运费成本和外币汇率波动、地缘政治冲突，包括持续的中东冲突和相关的供应链物流和成本影响、我们当前和长期的战略目标、我们品牌的预期表现和对我们产品的需求、我们品牌的预期影响、产品、营销、市场、分销和投资策略、我们的产品开发计划以及产品发布的时间和预期绩效、消费者行为的变化、我们获取新消费者和获得市场份额的能力、我们实现财务前景和多年框架的能力，包括预期收入、产品组合、利润、费用、库存水平、促销活动、预期全价销售率和每股收益、批发和分销商发货的时间、我们维持优质全价全球市场的能力、有关关税退款的声明以及我们产生自由现金流的能力并执行我们的资本配置策略，包括潜在的股票回购。"},{"id":14,"startTime":401,"endTime":426.37,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"Forward-looking statements made on this call represent management's current expectations and are based on information available at the time such statements are made. Forward-looking statements involve numerous known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors such as foreign currency rate fluctuations and changes to trade policies that may cause our actual results to differ materially from any results predicted, assumed, or implied by the forward-looking statements.","zh":"本次电话会议中做出的前瞻性陈述代表了管理层当前的预期，并基于做出此类陈述时可获得的信息。前瞻性陈述涉及许多已知和未知的风险、不确定性和其他因素，例如外币汇率波动和贸易政策变化，这些因素可能导致我们的实际结果与前瞻性陈述预测、假设或暗示的任何结果存在重大差异。"},{"id":15,"startTime":426.37,"endTime":446,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"The company has explained some of these risks and uncertainties in its SEC filings, including in the Risk Factors section of its annual report on Form 10-K and quarterly reports on Form 10-Q. Except as required by law or the listing rules of the New York Stock Exchange, the company expressly disclaims any intent or obligation to update any forward-looking statements.","zh":"该公司在其向 SEC 提交的文件中解释了其中一些风险和不确定性，包括其 10-K 表年度报告和 10-Q 表季度报告的风险因素部分。除法律或纽约证券交易所上市规则要求外，该公司明确否认有任何更新任何前瞻性陈述的意图或义务。"},{"id":16,"startTime":446,"endTime":466.74,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"On this call, management may refer to financial measures that were not prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S., including constant currency as well as free cash flow. For example, the company reports comparable direct-to-consumer sales on a constant currency basis for operations that were open throughout the current and prior reporting periods.","zh":"在这次电话会议上，管理层可能会参考未按照美国公认会计原则制定的财务指标，包括恒定汇率和自由现金流。例如，该公司以固定货币为基础报告了当前和之前报告期间开放业务的可比较的直接面向消费者的销售额。"},{"id":17,"startTime":466.74,"endTime":487.91,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"The company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures are useful supplemental indicators of its operating performance because they exclude items that are unrelated to and may not be indicative of its core operating results. Additionally, free cash flow is defined as net cash provided by operating activities for a particular period, less capital expenditures made during that same period.","zh":"该公司认为，这些非公认会计准则财务指标是其经营业绩的有用补充指标，因为它们排除了与其核心经营业绩无关且可能无法表明其核心经营业绩的项目。此外，自由现金流定义为特定时期经营活动提供的净现金减去同期的资本支出。"},{"id":18,"startTime":487.91,"endTime":499,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"The company believes free cash flow is a useful supplemental measure of liquidity as it reflects the cash generated from operations after investments required to support the strategic growth of the business.","zh":"该公司认为自由现金流是流动性的有用补充指标，因为它反映了支持业务战略增长所需的投资后运营产生的现金。"},{"id":19,"startTime":499,"endTime":507,"speaker":"Erinn Kohler","speakerType":"management","en":"Please review our earnings release published today for additional information regarding our non-GAAP financial measures. With that, I'll now turn it over to Stefano.","zh":"请查看我们今天发布的收益报告，了解有关我们的非公认会计准则财务指标的更多信息。有了这个，我现在将把它交给斯特凡诺。"},{"id":20,"startTime":507,"endTime":512.34,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Thanks, Erinn. Good afternoon, and thank you all for joining today's call.","zh":"谢谢，艾琳。下午好，感谢大家参加今天的电话会议。"},{"id":21,"startTime":512.34,"endTime":537.03,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"For the first time in Deckers' history, we delivered over $1 billion of revenue in the first quarter, as total company revenue increased 5.7% versus last year, and diluted earnings per share was $0.94, both above our expectations for the quarter. As anticipated, performance was led by total company DTC, which increased 13% versus last year.","zh":"在 Deckers 历史上，我们第一次在第一季度实现了超过 10 亿美元的收入，公司总收入比去年增长了 5.7%，摊薄后每股收益为 0.94 美元，均高于我们对本季度的预期。正如预期的那样，公司整体 DTC 的表现领先，与去年相比增长了 13%。"},{"id":22,"startTime":537.03,"endTime":561.57,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Both HOKA and UGG maintained solid momentum and continued to capture high level of full price consumer demand, driving global DTC revenue growth of 17% and 6% respectively. Wholesale channel growth was in line with our expectation, which included planned international shipment timing differences moving later this year as compared to last.","zh":"HOKA和UGG均保持强劲势头，继续抓住高水平的全价消费者需求，带动全球DTC收入分别增长17%和6%。批发渠道的增长符合我们的预期，其中包括与去年相比，今年晚些时候计划的国际发货时间差异。"},{"id":23,"startTime":561.57,"endTime":569,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Underlying consumer demand for our brands remains strong across international markets and domestically.","zh":"国际市场和国内消费者对我们品牌的潜在需求仍然强劲。"},{"id":24,"startTime":569,"endTime":584.03,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"HOKA and UGG each delivered healthy first quarter growth and full price unit sell-through in the U.S. market. I'm especially pleased with our progress across innovation and product newness, which are resonating globally.","zh":"HOKA 和 UGG 第一季度在美国市场均实现了健康的增长和全价销量。我对我们在创新和新品创新方面取得的进展感到特别满意，这在全球范围内引起了共鸣。"},{"id":25,"startTime":584.03,"endTime":603.43,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"The engagement we're seeing is not limited to a single region, channel, or product family. It reflects the broader impact of our consistent approach to creating distinctive consumer-led products that connect emotionally, perform exceptionally, and amplify the relevance of our brands.","zh":"我们看到的参与并不局限于单个地区、渠道或产品系列。它反映了我们一贯的方法所产生的更广泛的影响，即创造以消费者为主导的独特产品，这些产品能够在情感上产生联系，表现出色，并增强我们品牌的相关性。"},{"id":26,"startTime":603.43,"endTime":635,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"We have been disciplined in how we're managing supply, protecting brand heat, and avoiding unnecessary promotional pressure reflected in both the quality of our inventories and high levels of full price business. This gives us greater flexibility and visibility as we plan forward because we are operating from a stronger inventory position with cleaner channels, better pricing integrity, and continued consumer demand for the products we're bringing to market.","zh":"我们在管理供应、保护品牌热度以及避免不必要的促销压力方面一直遵守纪律，这体现在我们的库存质量和高水平的全价业务上。这为我们未来的计划提供了更大的灵活性和可见性，因为我们的库存状况更强，渠道更清洁，定价更诚信，消费者对我们推向市场的产品有持续的需求。"},{"id":27,"startTime":635,"endTime":650.42,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"These results reinforce our confidence in our fiscal 2027 outlook and multi-year framework. Our teams are bringing new and innovative ideas to market at the right time while staying focused on quality, authenticity, and long-term brand health.","zh":"这些结果增强了我们对 2027 财年前景和多年框架的信心。我们的团队在适当的时间将新的创新理念推向市场，同时专注于质量、真实性和长期品牌健康。"},{"id":28,"startTime":650.42,"endTime":682.26,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"We remain committed to the fundamentals that have long differentiated Deckers, building powerful brands, preserving a pull model of demand, and investing with purpose to enhance our competitive positioning and capitalize on the opportunities ahead. While the consumer backdrop remains pressured, we continue to see people showing up for the brands they love, and we believe the compelling product pipeline for both HOKA and UGG will support continued market share gains throughout this year and beyond.","zh":"我们仍然致力于长期使 Deckers 脱颖而出的基本原则，打造强大的品牌，保留需求的拉动模型，并有目的地进行投资，以增强我们的竞争地位并利用未来的机会。尽管消费者背景仍然面临压力，但我们继续看到人们购买他们喜爱的品牌，我们相信 HOKA 和 UGG 引人注目的产品线将支持今年及以后市场份额的持续增长。"},{"id":29,"startTime":682.26,"endTime":692.79,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Steve will provide further details on our first quarter results and fiscal year 2027 outlook later in the call. First, I will share an update on Q1 brand performance.","zh":"Steve 将在稍后的电话会议中提供有关我们第一季度业绩和 2027 财年展望的更多详细信息。首先，我将分享第一季度品牌表现的最新情况。"},{"id":30,"startTime":692.79,"endTime":694,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Starting with HOKA.","zh":"从霍卡开始。"},{"id":31,"startTime":694,"endTime":711.91,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"Global revenue in the first quarter increased 8% versus last year to $704 million. HOKA performance was driven by global DTC revenue increasing 17%, with all international regions continuing to deliver robust growth and the U.S. maintaining positive momentum.","zh":"第一季度全球收入比去年增长 8%，达到 7.04 亿美元。 HOKA 业绩受到全球 DTC 收入增长 17% 的推动，所有国际地区继续实现强劲增长，美国保持积极势头。"},{"id":32,"startTime":711.91,"endTime":744.33,"speaker":"Stefano Caroti","speakerType":"management","en":"DTC growth was broad-based across HOKA franchise families, with continued strong demand for our most popular products alongside well-received updates to emerging models in the assortment. And so we have tightened buys and moderated sell-in plans for the near term.","example":"After sell-through weakened, moderated sell-in plans reduced near-term wholesale revenue but lowered the risk of inventory being pushed into the channel.","exampleZh":"终端销售走弱后，放缓批发出货计划会压低近期批发收入，但能降低库存被硬推入渠道的风险。"},{"word":"must-win doors","definition":"must-win doors uses door in the retail sense of a store, wholesale account, or point of sale where distribution quality and productivity can be measured.","chineseDefinition":"必须拿下的关键零售点位；door在这里指门店或批发销售点，不是字面“门”","irUsage":"适合用于判断批发渠道、直营渠道和合作伙伴库存是否健康，重点连接 sell-in、sell-through、reorders、渠道库存和全价销售质量。","collocations":["invest in must-win doors（投入关键必争点位）","prioritize must-win doors（优先布局关键必争点位）"],"relatedExpressions":["points of distribution（分销点位）","retail productivity（零售效率）"],"sourceSentence":"In the near term, we're executing, cleaning up inventory, investing in must-win doors.","example":"If must-win doors only increases shipments into the channel, 指把规模调到合适水平，不是单纯削减","irUsage":"用于解释渠道收缩、物流网络优化和批发收入基数重置之间的关系，尤其适合判断增长是否回到真实需求节奏。","collocations":[],"relatedExpressions":["distribution network optimization（分销网络优化）","channel 指支撑业务运行的成本和费用结构，不只是单项成本","irUsage":"用于说明费用和运营结构要匹配新的收入水平，尤其适合放在毛利桥接、经营杠杆和转型期盈利基数中判断。","collocations":[],"relatedExpressions":["cost-base reset（成本基础重置）","operating tariffs, taking initial steps to reset our cost base and improve operating efficiency and effectiveness and our balance sheet is strong with substantial liquidity and flexibility to operate as we go forward.","example":"Resetting the cost base changes the margin story only after the lower expense run rate shows up alongside stable service levels and product flow.","exampleZh":"只有更低的费用运行水平与稳定的服务水平和货品流转同时出现，重置成本基础才会真正改变利润率叙事。"},{"word":"dynamic cost headwind","definition":"dynamic cost headwind identifies a trade-duty or customs mechanism that should be separated from pricing, sourcing, freight, and mix in the gross-margin bridge.","chineseDefinition":"动态成本逆风；dynamic 强调成本压力仍会随政策、采购地和缓释动作变化，不是固定的一次性费用","irUsage":"用于毛利桥接中区分固定成本压力和仍需滚动更新的关税、物流或原材料成本压力。","collocations":["cost absorption（成本吸收）","cost optimization（成本优化）"],"relatedExpressions":["operating leverage（经营杠杆）","expense run rate（费用运行水平）"],"sourceSentence":"Tariffs remain a dynamic cost headwind that we expect to continue looking forward.","example":"A dynamic cost headwind should stay visible in the margin bridge until sourcing actions and pricing offsets are reflected in actual gross margin.","exampleZh":"动态成本逆风应在毛利率桥接中单独保留，直到采购调整和定价抵消已经体现在实际毛利率里。"},{"word":"digital promotions","definition":"digital promotions refers to discount or incentive activity that can support revenue but usually lowers realized price and gross margin.","chineseDefinition":"线上促销；digital 指线上/电商渠道，promotions 指折扣、活动和促销资源，不是普通宣传","irUsage":"用于解释电商收入放缓、全价销售恢复和毛利率同比桥接，尤其适合拆分促销基数影响。","collocations":["pull back promotions（收缩促销）","promotional cadence（促销节奏）"],"relatedExpressions":["promotional equating to a multipoint headwind, including higher digital promotions in the prior year in EMEA and timing of North America wholesale shipments.","example":"When prior-year digital promotions roll off, revenue may slow while gross margin improves through lower markdown activity.","exampleZh":"当上年线上促销退出同比基数后，收入可能放缓，但毛利率会受益于降价活动减少。"},{"word":"full price realization","definition":"full price realization describes revenue or demand achieved without markdown support, making it a cleaner signal of brand heat and margin quality.","chineseDefinition":"全价实现率；不是泛泛full price，而是衡量折扣减少后实际价格质量恢复","irUsage":"适合用于拆解收入质量和毛利率质量，判断增长来自全价需求、价格纪律和产品结构，还是由促销、清货或低价渠道拉动。","collocations":["full-price sales（全价销售）","full-price integrity（全价体系完整性）"],"relatedExpressions":["price realization（价格兑现）","markdown rate（降价率）"],"sourceSentence":"This resulted in a 15-point improvement in full price realization.","example":"If full price realization comes from clearance rather than full-price demand, the quarter can improve while future margin quality weakens.","exampleZh":"如果全价实现率来自清货而不是全价需求，当季表现可能改善，但未来毛利质量会变弱。"},{"word":"closeout mix","definition":"closeout mix describes selling through marked-down or end-of-life product, often separating inventory cleanup from healthier full-price demand.","chineseDefinition":"清仓货品占比。熟词生义：mix 指业务结构占比，例如产品、渠道、区域或价格带组合，不是简单的“混合”","irUsage":"用于判断库存清理是否仍在拖累毛利和品牌价格形象。","collocations":["elevated closeout mix（较高尾货占比）","reduce closeout mix（降低尾货占比）"],"relatedExpressions":["off-price mix（折扣渠道占比）","end-of-life product（生命周期末端产品）"],"sourceSentence":"Inventory grew mid-single digits, in line with our plans with a healthy closeout mix.","example":"Cleaner partner inventory makes closeout mix more credible because replenishment can follow demand instead of clearance needs.","exampleZh":"合作伙伴库存更干净时，清仓货品占比更可信，因为补货可以跟随需求，而不是服务于清货需要。"},{"word":"wholesale comp","definition":"wholesale comp refers to comparable-store performance, a same-base view that strips out the effect of new doors or distribution expansion.","chineseDefinition":"批发渠道可比增长；comp 在这里指可比口径，不是薪酬或补偿","irUsage":"用于拆分批发收入增长是否来自真实渠道需求，而不是退货、准备金、取消订单或发货时点变化。","collocations":["same-store growth（同店增长）","comp-store trend（可比店趋势）"],"relatedExpressions":["comparable-store sales（可比店销售）","store productivity（门店效率）"],"sourceSentence":"It isn't just -- that wasn't just a wholesale comp.","example":"A reported wholesale comp needs adjustment when lower returns and cancellations explain more of the growth than partner reorders.","exampleZh":"当退货和取消订单减少比合作伙伴补单更能解释增长时，报表口径的批发可比增长需要重新调整。"}]

Eurozone inflation reached 3% in April, the highest level since September 2023, driven by 11% increase in energy costs.","zh":"2026年3月，美国年通胀率跃升至3.3%，创下2024年5月以来的最高水平，较2月和1月的2.4%大幅上升。受能源成本上涨 11% 的推动，欧元区 4 月份通胀率达到 3%，为 2023 年 9 月以来的最高水平。"},{"id":13,"startTime":210.24,"endTime":228.44,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"Eurozone inflation is broadly expected to remain elevated throughout the remainder of 2026. The U.S.Supreme Court ruling striking down IEEPA tariffs has actually increased our tariff exposure, at least temporarily.","zh":"普遍预计欧元区通胀将在 2026 年剩余时间内保持高位。美国最高法院裁定取消 IEEPA 关税实际上增加了我们的关税风险，至少是暂时的。"},{"id":14,"startTime":228.44,"endTime":244.06,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"We estimate our refund claims will be about EUR 30 million, but timing is still uncertain. In this challenging environment, we performed strongly. We once again demonstrated the resilience of our business model.","zh":"我们预计退款金额约为 3000 万欧元，但具体时间仍不确定。在这个充满挑战的环境中，我们表现强劲。我们再次证明了我们商业模式的弹性。"},{"id":15,"startTime":245.3,"endTime":263.8,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"In the second quarter, we grew revenues over 14% within our target range of 13%-15% growth in constant currency. Our adjusted EBITDA margin remained strong at over 32% despite the impact of FX and tariffs.","zh":"第二季度，我们的收入增长了 14% 以上，按固定汇率计算，收入增长在 13%-15% 的目标范围内。尽管受到外汇和关税的影响，我们的调整后 EBITDA 利润率仍保持在 32% 以上的强劲水平。"},{"id":16,"startTime":265.24,"endTime":280.68,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"Even in this uncertain environment, demand for Birkenstock remains strong. We delivered as promised in our white space growth opportunities. Closed toe penetration was up 300 basis points, driven by strong growth in clogs.","zh":"即使在这种不确定的环境下，对 Birkenstock 的需求仍然强劲。我们兑现了空白增长机会的承诺。在木鞋强劲增长的推动下，包头鞋渗透率上升了 300 个基点。"},{"id":17,"startTime":281.9,"endTime":297.32,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"APAC grew at over 2 x the pace of the other regions. Share of business was up over 100 basis points year-over-year. We opened 5 new owned retail doors, bringing the total globally to 111.","zh":"亚太地区的增长速度是其他地区的两倍以上。业务份额同比增长超过 100 个基点。我们开设了 5 家新的自营零售店，使全球门店总数达到 111 家。"},{"id":18,"startTime":299.14,"endTime":320.7,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"We are well on track to meet our target of 140 doors by the end of fiscal 2026. Importantly, within our D2C business, our own retail grew over 60% in constant currency. Same store sales were up double digits, accelerating from the first quarter.","zh":"我们正在顺利实现到 2026 财年末开设 140 家门店的目标。重要的是，在我们的 D2C 业务中，我们自己的零售额按固定汇率计算增长了 60% 以上。同店销售额增长两位数，较第一季度加速。"},{"id":19,"startTime":321.86,"endTime":343,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"We also continued to invest in our online business to drive better conversion and higher growth. Our Americas business remains strong, up 14% in constant currency. It was driven by very strong B2B growth and sell-through at partner doors, which was up over 30% at key partners.","zh":"我们还继续投资在线业务，以推动更好的转化和更高的增长。我们的美洲业务依然强劲，按固定汇率计算增长了 14%。这是由非常强劲的 B2B 增长和合作伙伴的销售量推动的，主要合作伙伴的销售量增长了 30% 以上。"},{"id":20,"startTime":344.4,"endTime":364.68,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"Youth retailers and sporting specialty continued to lead the B2B growth. The in-person shopping trend continues. Within the Americas D2C business, we saw strong same-store growth, and we added two new stores in the Americas, bringing the total to 17.","zh":"青年零售商和体育专业继续引领 B2B 增长。亲自购物的趋势仍在继续。在美洲 D2C 业务中，我们看到了强劲的同店增长，并在美洲增加了两家新店，使总数达到 17 家。"},{"id":21,"startTime":366.2,"endTime":388.44,"speaker":"Oliver Reichert","speakerType":"management","en":"Growth in EMEA was 11% in constant currency. A strong result when considering the negative impacts of the wars in the Middle East.
